articleTitle: Advanced Spirometer Based Human Respiration Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In recent years, the evaluation of a certain organ in the human body has become increasingly significant. The lungs' breathing behavior is very important for children, adults, and the elderly. The various parameters of the human lungs, including inhalation, exhalation, and respiratory pressure level, have been tracked using well-known embedded sensors and controller units. This validation of the lungs is particularly useful for diagnosing all respiration-related diseas es. Spirometers are computer-based devices that have been designed as an immediate responder for the lungs. The maximum and minimum capacity levels of breathing play an important role in human health. The Internet of Things has been employed to improve the performance of the propos ed system at the highest levels.

articleTitle: Revamping Primary Programming Education with Augmented Reality Teaching via EnvisionAR
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This study introduces a transformative approach to primary programming education, leveraging Augmented Reality (AR) teaching methodologies through the innovative EnvisionAR platform. In response to the dynamic technological landscape, this research addresses the need for engaging, immersive learning experiences for young learners. The EnvisionAR platform, a pioneering fusion of AR technology and tailored curriculum, caters to the cognitive development stages of primary school students. By seamlessly integrating virtual elements into the physical environment, students engage in interactive, hands-on learning that cultivates creativity, problem solving skills, and a profound understanding of programming concepts. This research signifies a broader potential for AR integration in diverse educational disciplines.

articleTitle: IoT Based Solution for Monitoring Pesticide Level in Fruits and Vegetables
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Nowadays most of the people are focusing on their health and a healthy diet. Fruits and vegetables are included as an important part of such a diet. But many of the fruits and vegetables are grown by using fertilizers, pesticides and steroids to improve the quantity and profit, thus the adverse health consequences on individuals brought on by the use of pesticides, steroids, and fertilizers have escalated. Fruits and vegetables are becoming one of the main sources of harmful pesticides that enter the body, so it's important to find the best way to monitor pesticide levels in food samples. With the aid of sensors and a microcontroller, a prototype of the system is developed in this project to gather information on the presence of pesticides. As a result, hardware and software designs are employed to acquire real-time results. Embedded C is used to code the maximum amount of pesticide that people can consume without suffering any negative health effects. The result is shown to the user through an android application with a good user interface.

articleTitle: A Survey on - Accessible Visual Information Retrieval (AVIR)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research study analyzes Accessible Visual Information Retrieval (AVIR), an evolving domain at the crossroads of computer vision, accessibility, and information retrieval. This research study focuses on analyzing the critical role of AVIR in democratizing access to visual information, enabling inclusivity in various domains such as education, navigation, and digital content consumption. This study intends to explore methodologies that augment accessibility, including image captioning, audio descriptions, and multimodal interfaces, to cater to diverse user requirements. Furthermore, this work addressesthe inherent challenges in AVIR, such as ensuring accuracy in content descriptions, adapting to dynamic visual contexts, and optimizing user interfaces for seamless interaction. Finally, novel techniques leveraging machine learning, natural language processing, and human-computer interaction paradigms are proposed to overcome these challenges. Moreover, this study underscores the ethical implications and societal impact of AVIR advancements, emphasizing the importance of designing systems that not only improve accessibility but also respect privacy, cultural diversity, and individual preferences. Through a comprehensive synthesis of advancements and challenges, this study provides a roadmap for researchers, developers, and practitioners in furthering the accessibility of visual information and aims to foster collaborations and innovations in AVIR that are both technically robust and ethically sound, ultimately advancing the goal of a more inclusive and accessible digital landscape for all.

articleTitle: Imperative Role of Internet of Things in Power Plant Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Internet of Things is utilized by multiple applications in field of energy generation power plants. This study discusses about the implementation of IoT based smart systems with power plants i.e., solar power plant, wind power plant, geothermal power plants and hydropower plant. The study discuses about monitoring of the function parameters of power plants while resolving the real-time fault detection in systems. The paper further emphasizes on IoT features about better access of data, decision-making, sustainability, greater collaboration of technologies of sensors, micro-controllers and communication protocols; whereas self-healing IoT devices with auto calibration which improves reliability of systems gives the further point to researchers to create something new.

articleTitle: Optimized Hybrid Metaheuristic Model for MapReduce Task Scheduling Applications - A Novel Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: It takes a lot of time and work to process huge file sizes on a single processor. To meet real-time constraints, tasks must be divided into smaller subtasks and executed parallelly on multiple processors in order to be processed efficiently. MapReduce is a programming model that allows for the effective and efficient processing of tasks involving large amounts of data. It divides the large task into smaller subtasks and distributes these subtasks across a large number of VMs for execution. Scheduling these tasks on a set of available virtual machines increases execution time, consumes energy, and raises security concerns. The scheduling of large tasks under the constraints of available resources can be made more effective and efficient by optimizing these parameters of interest. A framework of the optimized hybrid metaheuristic model for MapReduce task scheduling process is presented here. It combines two well-known task scheduling algorithms, Moth Flame optimization (MFO) and Tunicate Swarm optimization (TSO). In this case, the advantages of both algorithms are combined to present an improved framework for scheduling multiple tasks on a limited number of VMs. It improves the scheduling process by optimizing important factors like make-span and cost of execution. When compared to well-known existing models, the proposed framework can optimize the important parameters of MapReduce task scheduling

articleTitle: Vechicular Accident Detection and Alert Generation Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Smart accident detection systems are those that recognize accidents automatically. The Internet of Things, or IoT, can connect the detectors and transmit the information to the destination. It can also perform operations based on data collected by detectors, which can aid in the detection of accidents. The information obtained from detectors is also provided to the appropriate authorities, like police and emergency medical services. This research study examines some of the most modern methods of detecting car accidents using IoT technologies. The challenges faced by existing methodologies and a porotype model has also been developed to detect the accidents.

articleTitle: Design of Blind Assistive System Using Internet of Things-A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Blindness, commonly denoted as visual impairment, poses challenges for individuals in performing everyday activities such as walking, reading, social interaction, and driving. This research presents an Internet of Things (IoT) enabled smart stick. The proposed smart stick incorporates features such as obstacle identification module, GPS based detection, pit and flights of stairs detection, and IoT connectivity to facilitate efficient execution of daily tasks. The obstacle identification module utilizes both ultrasonic and other sensor technologies to detect obstacles, involving the identification of obstruction patterns and recognition of obstacles as interruptions. The GPS and IoT modules determine the user's current position, and in the event of a loss, the smart stick automatically activates an alarm mode. The efficacy of the introduced functionalities is validated through various test scenarios. This technologically advanced walking sticks not only aids individuals with visual impairments but also contributes to the advancement of science and technology.

articleTitle: Securing IoT: Anomaly Detection and Behavioral Analysis for Data Integrity
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is a hub for many internet-connected devices, however IoT devices with limited resources have inherent security risks when sending data. This study presents a new paradigm that uses anomaly detection and behavioural analysis to improve security in cloud-based IoT communication. This method, in contrast to conventional cryptographic methods, concentrates on closely examining device behaviour to identify anomalous patterns, guaranteeing data integrity and confidentiality throughout transmission. In order to strengthen the security of data transfer inside IoT sensor networks, this research provides a unique method that uses machine learning andbehavioural analysis customized for IoT devices to identify anomalous behavior. By putting these approaches into practice, this system aims to greatly increase the resilience of IoT communication networks against possible attacks, creating a more secure framework for data transfer and exchange in the IoT environment.

articleTitle: Development of Serial Driver Verification Environment Module Using UVM Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The development of a Serial Driver Verification Environment Module using UVM is a critical component ensuring the reliable and robust operation of serial communication interfaces in modern electronic systems. This module serves as a key part of verification process helping to identify and rectify potential issues and bugs in the serial driver's functionality. The UVM is a widely accepted and standardized framework for verifying digital designs by ensuring their compliance with industry standards. This methodology provides a structured and systematic approach to the verification process, enabling through testing of the serial driver in various scenarios and corner cases. The proposed involves the creation of a verification environment module tailored specifically to the serial driver by utilizing UVM principles and methodologies. The module will include test benches, sequences, and monitors designed to thoroughly test the serial driver's functionality, performance, and compliance with relevant communication protocols.

Author Keywords: Data verification in communication and transmission

articleTitle: A Security Enhanced Authentication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) have gained popularity in recent times. With an increase in the number of IoT devices, security and privacy vulnerabilities are also increasing. For sensitive domains like healthcare and industrial sectors, such vulnerabilities can cause havoc. Thus, authentication is an important aspect for establishing a secure communication between various participants. In this paper, two recent authentication and key exchange protocols are studied. It is demonstrated that these protocols are susceptible to replay attacks, modification attacks, and technical correctness issues. Possible improvements to address these vulnerabilities are also presented. The enhancements are designed to preserve the performance of the original protocols.

articleTitle: Climatic Categorization Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This study deals with development and evaluation of two ANN (Artificial Neural Network) based models for categorization of the climate types into 3 classes viz. Arid, Temperate, and Tropical. The classification models are configured and trained using two different approaches, viz. Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN), and Learning Vector Quantization (LVQ) in MATLAB. The models have been trained on dataset including climate related attributes, and finally evaluated based on the classification accuracy. The PNN technique has the ability to capture complex patterns within the data by computing probability densities. The LVQ technique creates the codebook of vectors for representing different classes and utilizing vector quantization. For training both the models, a secondary dataset is used by including four parameters - Temperature, Humidity, Wind speed, and Rainfall. Finally, the performance of developed models is evaluated based on its ability to accurately classify the new unseen data.

articleTitle: Literature Review on Packet Sniffing: Essential for Cybersecurity & Network Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the realm of cybersecurity and network security, the significance of monitoring and analyzing network traffic cannot be overstated Network packet sniffing, a technique employed to capture and inspect data packets traversing a network, has emerged as an imperative tool for understanding network behavior, identifying vulnerabilities, and enhancing overall security. This study analyzes packet sniffing by exploring its role in modern cybersecurity practices. By analyzing packet sniffing mechanisms, including its methodologies and potential applications, this res earch sheds light on its effectiveness as a proactive security solution. Furthermore, the study examines the ethical considerations surrounding packet sniffing, addressing concerns related to user privacy and data protection. It also investigates the legal aspects that govern the use of packet sniffing techniques, ensuring compliance with regulations while maximizing its benefits. Through case studies and real-world examples, this research illustrates how packet sniffing can be leveraged to detect network anomalies, thwart malicious activities, and fortify network infrastructures. By presenting a comprehensive overview of packet sniffing's capabilities and limitations, this study equips cybersecurity practitioners with the knowledge needed to make informed decisions about its integration into their defensive strategies.

articleTitle: An Efficient Framework for Secure Agriculture Block Supply Chain for Farmer with Crop Yield and Demand Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: An entire country's economy, population security, nutrition, and health all depend on its agricultural productivity. In an effort to increase agricultural output, farmers have been adopting new technologies like blockchain and the Internet of Things in recent years. Blockchain has been used to address issues in a variety of industries. Blockchain is being used in agriculture to speed up transaction times and improve food safety. The complex mechanism that keeps agricultural products moving throughout the market is called an agricultural supply chain. Agricultural commercial resources play a crucial role in meeting the demand for agricultural products and preserving their quality and safety as they transport agricultural items across the market. Many existing methods have explored the use of blockchains in the supply chain, although they are unable to enhance the process's overall efficiency. An efficient crop yield prediction and demand prediction system is proposed with secure block chain technology. The proposed system has the following three phases: 1) crop yield prediction system; 2) supply chain process with blockchain; and 3) demand prediction system. The first phase consists of the following steps: dataset collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, feature selection, and training. In the second phase, farmers, distributors, retailers, and consumers are involved. Finally, for demand prediction, pre-processing, feature extraction, feature reduction, and prediction are carried out. All three phases are linked to a blockchain and securely stored in the cloud.

articleTitle: Improved Heart Sound Classification Using LSTM Based Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The goal of this research is to categorize heart sounds using phonocardiogram (PCG) data using machine learning and deep learning techniques, which are crucial for the early diagnosis of cardiovascular illness. The five different classes that make up the dataset are extrastole, extrahls, murmur, artefact, and normal. In order to extract features using Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC), preprocessing entails normalization. This is essential for capturing distinctive sound characteristics. For classification, four models are used: Random Forest, Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). The results demonstrate how well LSTM performs, with an astounding accuracy of almost 94.5% in heart sound classification. This result emphasizes how useful deep learning architectures-in particular, LSTM-are for heart sound classification tasks that depend on MFCC-based features. According to the study, LSTM-based approaches have the potential to greatly improve identification precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Methane Emission using ARIMA Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Scientists hypothesized that the primary catalyst for global climate change is an increase in the concentration of greenhouse gas emissions, particularly methane, in the atmosphere. The compelling reasons to priorities attention to methane are its high global warming potential and long atmospheric half-life. The atmospheric gas profiles are significantly impacted by human activities on a daily basis. The immediate mitigation of global warming could be achieved by directly implementing actions to reduce methane emissions. In light of the aforementioned points, it can be asserted that monitoring future methane levels by analyzing past data is crucial for understanding the trajectory of climate change in the coming decades. To achieve this objective, we suggest employing a technique that makes use of cutting-edge ARIMA models, which have exhibited exceptional efficacy in predicting time-series data. The primary objectives of this study are to determine the most suitable ARIMAmodel (pdq) and to predict methane emissions for a 12-year duration till 2035.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Developing a Smart Trolley with Internet of Things and RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: With the integration of Internet of Things (IoT), Smart trolley technology has significantly revolutionized the retail experience by removing traditional checkout wait times. Payments for shopping baskets can be performed quickly and easily with RFID technology. Even though the existing techniques have substantially improved the retail's simplicity and productivity. To overcome these challenges, this research study intends to improve data security standards, handle any potential technological concerns, and enhance the system's dependability. Innovative CartTech technology seeks to position itself as a market leader in intelligent purchasing systems and provide customers with the finest buying experience possible, thus it is continuously working to develop in these areas. The CartTech system's precision is achieved by the integration of modern technology. The RFID reader enables precise product identification and pricing, while load cells provide real-time weight readings to improve inventory control. NodeMCU modules provide fast data transmission to the cloud while also producing instantaneous updates on the LCD display and a streamlined, trustworthy shopping experience.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Face Recognition Algorithm: Convolution Neural Network Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Heterogeneous face recognition, also known as HFR, is an approach to facial recognition that attempts to match facial pictures that have been gathered through a variety of sensory modalities. HFR is primarily used for forensics, network security, and all commercial applications. The heterogeneous face recognition (HFR) algorithm is robust in handling challenges that exist in conventional face recognition. This is since heterogeneous face images display an enormous amount of intra- class variation, and it does not support hybrid modality of face images. This study provides a unique technique to transfer learning as a means of mastering invariant facial feature characteristics in visual (VIS) face pictures. A wrapping procedure combines end to end connections of two components for deep network. A discriminator has the details of fine-grained data for improving the quality of image which depends on wavelets. The system is made up of two different modules: one deals with face recognition, while the other determines a person's gender. It analysis about the characteristics of gender from the image using Convolutional Neural Networks that have been pre-trained. To train CNN in the face recognition module, in particular, the use of the open-source datasets Labelled Faces within the Wild, YouTube Face, and VGGFace2 results in an improvement in accuracy. Deep learning techniques and a substantial number of photographic examples of people's faces are what make it feasible for the proposed recognition to function so admirably. The problem of studying recognition remains challenging due to the limited size of the sample and the information gap between the senses.

articleTitle: Blood Guard: An IoT Based Innovative RFID-Enhanced Blood Storage System with Biometric Security and Real-Time Temperature Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has currently developed a delivery system for medical supplies with the help of drones, called the “i-Drone” initiative. This research work aims to propose an idea, which will help in making a valuable addition to this initiative and make it smarter and more secure through the addition of several new features including RFID tags, fingerprint sensors, temperature sensors and integration with ThingSpeak and IFTTT. RFID tags will enable real-time tracking of blood bags ensuring that they are always in the right place. Fingerprint sensors will restrict access to authorized personnel, preventing unauthorized tampering. Temperature sensors will monitor the temperature of blood bags and send an alert if it falls below a safe level, ensuring that blood bags are always safe and viable. Integration with ThingSpeak and IFTTT will allow the temperature of blood bags to be displayed on a dashboard and for email alerts to be sent to registered users when the temperature drops below a safe level, providing additional transparency and accountability.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of Different Machine Translation Evaluation Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Machine Translation (MT) systems mechanically represent a source language into a destination language while maintaining the originality of context using various Natural Language Processing approaches. The need to assess the translation quality produced by machine translation systems has grown as a result of their increased use. However, due to their complicated morphology and syntax, other low-resource languages might not always be appropriate for or applicable to the existing evaluation measures intended for English and other languages. The technique of evaluating machine translation is known as machine translation evaluation (MTE). In MTE, the amount of similarity and accuracy is determined by contrasting the output produced by the machine translation with the reference translation. The study assesses the metrics on several translation systems using datasets for low-resource languages. The paper advances the field of machine translation (MT) by illuminating appropriate evaluation criteria for low-resource languages. For this research. data from the Scopus database were gathered and analyzed using the keywords “machine translation” AND “evaluation metrics” from 1993 to 2023. Using Scopus databases, this article computes numerous application areas, documents published yearly, and keyword occurrences analysis. This work provides analysis and support for the significance of evaluation measures for different low-resource languages.

articleTitle: IoT based Optimal Energy Management System with Electricity Selling for Residential Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The Integration of smart technology and predictive algorithms enables real-time monitoring and adjustment, optimizing the utilization of renewable energy sources like solar power. These systems factor in weather forecasts to anticipate variations in solar generation, enhancing the efficiency of energy distribution within the household. Additionally, they facilitate remote monitoring and control, empowering users to track energy flow and make informed decisions to align with their economic objectives. Moreover, these advancements foster a more resilient energy infrastructure, reducing dependence on centralized power grids and mitigating the impact of grid failures or fluctuations. Furthermore, the evolving landscape of energy storage technologies complements these systems by using IoT, allowing for greater flexibility in managing energy surpluses and deficits. Efficient battery storage solutions facilitate the optimization of energy usage, further enhancing the economic benefits and reliability of residential PV systems. The system utilizes a machine learning-based predictive algorithm to forecast residential energy consumption patterns, optimizing electricity management by dynamically usage selling surplus energy back to the grid, ensuring efficient and cost-effective power utilization. The scalability of these solutions renders them adaptable to varying household needs and preferences, ensuring inclusivity across different demographics and geographic locations. This democratization of energy transactions contributes to a more sustainable and equitable energy landscape. Overall, the convergence of these technologies marks a significant step towards a resilient, decentralized, and environmentally friendly energy future.

articleTitle: Encrypted Honey Password Authentication for Online Banking System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The most popular authentication method is password authentication since it is inexpensive and simple to implement. Most users create their passwords with well-known words to make them easier to remember. Weak systems could expose passwords. Every day, new vulnerabilities are found and not every system can be patched in time to fend off attacks. This gives attackers a chance to get unauthorised access to vulnerable systems. This article proposes a password authentication framework that can be simply integrated into current authentication systems and is intended for secure password storage in order to counteract password attacks. In proposed framework, introduces a comprehensive security framework integrating innovative techniques to enhance password protection and user authentication. The approach involves the incorporation of honey words and the implementation of the AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) algorithm for secure password storage. The password storage mechanism employs honey words as decoy passwords, creating a deceptive layer for potential attackers. Additionally, the honey passwords are encrypted using AES, heightening the overall security posture. During the login process, users are authenticated through a combination of factors, encompassing traditional password authentication method using username and password. A critical component of the proposed system is the server-based generation and transmission of decryption keys during login. This key allows the client to decrypt the stored password securely. The inclusion of honey words further fortifies the verification process, as any attempt to access these decoy passwords triggers an alert. Upon successful verification, users gain access to the banking application, where they can engage in secure online transactions.

articleTitle: FarmTech: IoT-Based Agriculture Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: IoT in agriculture focuses on using sensors to analyze the soil conditions like temperature, nutrient levels, and pH, in real-time. The collected data is transmitted through IoT connectivity for analysis. The project uses machine learning algorithms to interpret the sensor data, providing insights into the best crop choices based on certain soil conditions. A user-friendly interface is developed to empower farmers with accessible data interpretation and crop recommendations. With a seamless interface it can be easily used by farmers. Through this approach, the project aims to enhance agricultural efficiency by enabling informed decision-making, optimizing crop planning, and promoting sustainable farming practices for a more resilient agricultural ecosystem

articleTitle: Master Street Light System Integrating Automation and Air Pollution Monitoring for Urban Sustainability
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the pursuit of sustainable urban development, our project proposes an innovative solution that combines smart street lighting and air pollution monitoring. The first phase focuses on automating street lighting through a master-student system, where a designated master street light, equipped with light sensors, controls adjacent street lights, reducing installation costs and enhancing system efficiency. The second phase extends the project's scope to environmental monitoring, incorporating air pollution sensors into each master street light. This creates a comprehensive data network, collecting real-time air quality data for transmission to relevant authorities. Our project addresses energy conservation and environmental awareness by seamlessly integrating smart street lighting with air pollution monitoring, offering a holistic solution for creating smarter, more sustainable urban spaces.

articleTitle: Astute Assistance System for Blind and Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: There are numerous hand-held obstacle detectors and ultrasonic guide devices available for individuals with visual impairments, all of which do not cause injury and allow them to cross roads safely. To assist them while crossing the roads, this study proposes a novel solution to guide at traffic junctions by utilizing listener commands. The proposed model works with the help of pedestrians at the crossing by activating the control system, temporarily pausing traffic signals, and directing them when to cross.

articleTitle: An Optimized Approach to Recommend, Retrieve Training Videos based on the Contents of Videos, and Documents
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Information Retrieval is an interesting area to fulfil the need for providing required contents to People who are looking for information based on key words. Any Organization has many Business Units (BUs). Each BU has many projects developed using different technologies. Employees are interested in getting cross skilled, upskilled in their interested technologies. Though all training courses provided by various BUs are recorded, there is no common repository and a system to search for these training videos by employees. These recordings are currently saved on Microsoft Streams, which will be available only for employees belonging to their own BU. These recordings will be auto deleted based on retention policy of Microsoft. Supporting documents shared by Trainers are not saved on Microsoft Streams. Currently, there is no system to recommend which training courses are best suited for employees based on their skills. Conducting Repetitive training about the same topics, loss of training recordings, time consumption to cross skill/upskill employees, accidental/intentional deletion of recording files are main drawbacks of the current system. In this proposal, all training recordings will be saved on a single repository to which only IT Admin, BU Project Management Office (PMO) team, and BU Leadership team will have access to recordings. A common Training System should be created and shared across employees to get recommendations for training based on their skills, also to search for their interested topics to retrieve corresponding training recordings and it is supporting documents in an optimized approach based on their search key words.

articleTitle: Classification of Fruits and its Quality Prediction using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Fruit classification is an indispensable component of the modern world, with applications ranging from agriculture and food production to retail and distribution. Accurate classification of fruits ensures quality control and helps in streamlining supply chains. However, fruit classification is a complex endeavor, primarily due to the intrinsic diversity of fruits in terms of size, shape, color, and other characteristics. The challenge intensifies when the goal is not only to identify fresh fruits but also to detect and classify rotten or spoiled ones. The existing models and systems designed for fruit classification have been proficient in categorizing fresh, visually appealing fruits. These models have found widespread utility in industries such as agriculture and supermarkets, where the goal is to separate fruits that meet certain quality standards. However, they fall short when it comes to addressing the critical issue of identifying and classifying fruits that are no longer fit for consumption, which is equally important to prevent waste and maintain quality control. To bridge this gap, this project develops a comprehensive approach. It begins with the acquisition of a dataset that includes both fresh and rotten fruits. By combining the power of deep learning, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), the project aims to classify fruits into distinct categories. The CNN model is trained to differentiate between fresh and rotten fruits by learning from a diverse set of images. In addition to classification, the project employs the capabilities of OpenCV, a popular computer vision library, to assess the ripeness of fruits based on the color. OpenCV provides a robust platform for analyzing color variations in fruit images. By leveraging this color analysis, the project can not only classify fruits but also determine their ripeness levels, providing a more holistic evaluation of fruit quality. The integration of CNN -based classification and OpenCV-driven ripeness assessment creates a comprehensive and practical solution for fruit quality evaluation. The proposed approach will have a significant impact across various sectors, from agriculture, where it aids in efficient fruit harvesting and sorting, to retail, where it ensures that only the finest produce reaches the consumers. Ultimately, this project seeks to address the challenges of fruit classification in terms of heterogeneity, offering a valuable tool for modern quality control and waste reduction efforts in the fruit industry.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Classifier with Optimized Clustering Algorithm for the Efficient Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Nowadays network security is becoming more and more challenging due to increasing number of network attacks. The major attack which carried out on the network seems to be DoS attack, DDoS attack, Botnet Attack and Bruteforce Attack. The proposed research work will classify the incoming packets in the cloud environment (through network) as attack or non-attack packets with best clustering and cluster head optimization algorithm. The overall classified cluster lead to further classification on the specified four major attacks with the better accuracy and other network intrusion measures. There are sorne fixed techniques associated in this classification and those are Principal Component Analysis PCA for extracting the features and AutoFncoder (classifier algorithm based on deep-learning) for classifying the attacks after clustering as attack and non-attack group. This research includes a CSE--CIC--IDS dataset which had more than 1.8 crore packets. These are the packets which are having above four major attacks and also includes SQL Injection and Infiltration attacks in lesser proportionate. The motive behind this research is to find the best fit of clustering algorithm with a combination of efficient cluster head optimization technique with the fixed technique of PCA based feature reduction and deep learning based classifier on to and from of clustering mechanism for betterment of intrusion classification accuracy and other network measures.

articleTitle: Creation of Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment Pipeline Using Cloud
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The demand for a robust delivery system for code and updates is increasing every day. Organizations are developing new ways to streamline the processes, so they can increase the efficiency of the project development, by using the automation in various steps such as testing, deployment, project monitoring which allows to remove the dependency on manual work, where the sharing of the progress of various development processes can cause to slow down the development cycle. Original Equipment manufacturers(OEM's) are not an exception with this fast-changing technology and industry shifting towards more software automobile solutions. They are also developing various tools to better deploy the software updates to vehicles in the field such as Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment(CI/CD) pipeline for the smoothing out of the software rollouts. The integration of Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) practices within Agile methodologies forms a symbiotic relationship that significantly enhances the efficiency of project delivery. In Agile, where iterative development and rapid releases are key, CI ensures continuous integration of code changes, fostering collaboration and early issue detection. Automated testing, a cornerstone of Agile, is seamlessly integrated into the CI/CD pipeline, providing rapid feedback to developers and maintaining high-quality software throughout development. The deployment phase, automated through Continuous Delivery, aligns with Agile's commitment to delivering valuable software frequently. Together, Agile's iterative approach and CI/CD's automation create a dynamic environment that promotes collaboration, responsiveness to change, and the swift delivery of working software. This cohesive integration of Agile principles with CI/CD practices establishes a foundation for teams to adapt, innovate, and consistently deliver customer value. The initial phase is the integration phase in which the Jenkins CI server will be used with various tools such as GitLab and Jira to start the development phase of the project. Using Jira as a monitoring tool and GitLab as a source management tool a new software can be developed in a fast way. Once the initial development is done, the next phase is testing where static tests and various other tests are automated using Xray. Once the testing is successful the project moves to deployment phase where the project is deployed to consumers using tools such as Jfrog artifactory and AWS EKS. Using a combination of these methods will allow to successfully deploy codes to the users with minimal intervention reducing the chances of error.

articleTitle: Power Generation Methods Classification using Ambiguous Fuzzy Averaging Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Finding the best ways to make power is a big decision that is affected by a lot of things that are linked to each other. This process is often messy and full of wrong knowledge. This paper uses the Ambiguous Fuzzy Averaging Operator (AFAO) to show a new way to look at and compare different ways of making electricity. In AFAO, different types of data are mixed together, even if some of them aren't clear or can't be trusted. When AFAO is used, factual data is collected that gives useful information about how efficient different power creation methods are compared to each other. The study shows the pros and cons of each method based on the set criteria, giving decision-makers a full understanding of the methods. This helps people who have to make decisions make smart choices that are in line with clear goals and limits. The comparison study is also looked at to show that the method being given can be used.

articleTitle: Facilitating Secure Information Transfer via Cloud with Hybrid Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Data security is the primary concern in the cloud, as various organizations are storing their data in cloud environment. This research work focuses on hybrid encryptions and their implementation and analysis on the cloud, for leveraging superior performance, increased algorithm speed, efficacy assessment, and comparison with existing algorithms. This study proposes a novel hybrid algorithm by combining the symmetric (Twofish) and asymmetric (RSA) cryptographic methods. Theoretically, this research study reveals the enhanced security of the proposed hybrid algorithm (Twofish+RSA). Also, this study compares the hybrid <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{AES} +\text{RSA}$</tex> approach for developing a balanced and secure solution for enabling data protection in various applications. Meanwhile, the Twofish+RSA hybrid model stands out for its advantages in computation time, ciphertext size, and memory consumption. Proposing a multilevel cryptography-based security solution is prompted by the growing research focus on cloud computing security. Security concerns are prevalent in this technology-driven world, where attackers can easily exploit flaws, particularly in the area of cloud computing.

articleTitle: Residential EV Charging Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) rely on battery capacity for energy storage, necessitating the use of an environmentally friendly battery management system (BMS) to maximize overall performance and enable a safe power switch. The proposed Battery Management and Optimization System (BMS) monitors parameters such as temperature and voltage, recognizes errors, and provides a user-friendly interface via a LCD display. EVs that are powered by rechargeable batteries differ from fossil-fuel-driven automobiles. The BMS regulates the percentage of battery operation, which improves performance, safety, and longevity. Thus, the BMS is critical in increasing EV efficiency, dependability, and safety.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Phishing Detection System Based on Federated Learning Integrated CNN-LSTM for SMS Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Phishing is one of the most common types of cybercrime. It is a method used by attackers to reveal personal information. The possibility of malicious activity is increasing in the rapidly changing the internet, where technological improvements enable seamless connectivity and information exchange. Conventional phishing detection techniques find it difficult to detect the dynamic strategies used by the malicious actors. This research study makes use of a hybrid Convolutional Long S hort-Term Memory (ConvLS TM) neural network to present a novel method for improving the detection rate of phishing in text-based communications. The core of the proposed system lies in combining the ConvLS TM architecture with a Federated Learning (FL) framework. The FL tackles the privacy and data decentralization challenges. This makes it possible to train the model on a variety of entities or organizations. The federated hybrid ConvLS TM model achieves higher accuracy, precision, and recall rates than conventional phishing detection techniques, as shown by the testing results. The proposed model can generalize well over a wide range of datasets from various organizations by utilizing the federated method, which further makes it a reliable and useful tool for detecting phishing attacks in an era where data safety and accuracy plays a major role.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Method for Recognition of Facial Expressions using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Facial Expression Recognition (FER) plays a vital role in most of the applications in which elders and challenged persons are involved. To improve the performance of facial expression recognition (FER), this research aims to reduce the impact of redundant input from emotional-unrelated regions. In order to achieve this, a hierarchically focused densely linked convolutional neural network is suggested. In particular, Facial Landmark Detection (FLD) is used as an auxiliary task and new learning strategies are explored in a new architectural network based on Spatial Transform Network (S TN) CNN. By using it, the unwanted areas from the image are removed. Also, S TN helps for restructure the image in a proper format if the image positioning is not in proper structure. Then, the comprehensiw studies were made with the benchmark facial expression datasets FER-2013 and CK+. The result shows that the performance i.e, accuracy of the proposed system outperforms the existing methods.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Facial Feature Extraction with AI: An Innovative Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This paper provides a technique for detecting human faces & extracting their features based on segmentation of skin tone & facial structure. The system goes through several stages. The method first searches for regions where faces might be present by segmenting skin tone. After performing various morphological operations on skin, it uses aspect ratio of a face to find viable face blocks. face blocks are then used to extract additional features. Therefore, one may identify and validate a person's image using their face features by using this biometric attribute. To enhance facial recognition, numerous researchers have employed Support Vector Machine (SVM), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), a combination of SVM and PCA, PCA with an Artificial Neural Network, and even the conventional PCA-SVM. Due to PCA-ANN's limited dataset limitation, PCA-SVM is superior to PCA-ANN. To extract features, relative location & size are used. If algorithm is unable to identify even one feature in a prospective face block, it rejects face block.

articleTitle: DenseNet Framework for Wood Quality Assessment: Predicting Defects in Wood Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Wood is an essential natural resource that is widely used in many different industries, but it is especially important in the building and furniture industries. On the other hand, flaws in wood like rot, cracks, and knots can seriously affect the material's overall quality and structural integrity. Conventional techniques for examining wood for flaws are frequently laborious and arbitrary. Modern technology, particularly deep learning, has been used more frequently in recent years to automate the process of diagnosing wood flaws. This research introduces a novel approach to wood quality assessment using the Dense Net deep learning architecture. The goal is to use image analysis to determine whether or not wood samples contain flaws. A carefully selected collection of photos of wood samples with and without defects is created, and preprocessing methods including scaling, normalization, and augmentation are used to it. Next, the DenseNet architecture is put into practice, improving information flow throughout the network by utilizing its distinct dense connectivity pattern. To guarantee strong performance on untested data, the model is assessed on a different test set after being trained on the dataset.

articleTitle: A Study on the Methods and Algorithms Used for the Separation of Speech Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Despite the fact that voice recognition is widely used and has many advantages, there are also a number of serious disadvantages of the methods used in it. This includes, first of all, the weakness of the ability to distinguish between the methods and the number of errors of the first type, that is, the number of falsely denied access, and the second type of error is the most dangerous, that is, the number of people falsely admitted to confidential information, who do not have access. This is especially complicated when performing identification in real conditions accompanied by a set of unfavorable external factors. In this work, methods and algorithms for distinguishing signs of speech signals were studied, and the results of experiments were obtained on the basis of the “rabbit-filter” speech generation model and the algorithm for finding Mel-cepstral coefficients.

articleTitle: Securing Electronic Health Records from Insider Threats in Smart City Healthcare Cloud Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In recent years, healthcare in smart cities is considered as significant to create a more resilient and well-informed healthcare ecosystem. The integration of cloud computing in healthcare industry has facilitated the storage and sharing of electronic health records (EHRs), enabling seamless access to medical information. However, this transition to cloud-based systems has introduced new security challenges, particularly the risk of insider threats. Insiders with authorized access to cloud-based EHR systems, such as healthcare professionals and cloud service providers, may exploit vulnerabilities or misuse sensitive patient data, leading to privacy breaches and unauthorized disclosure. This research work presents an innovative approach to securing EHRs from insider threats in the cloud using Gaussian Mixture Model and Classification algorithms. These techniques analyze user behaviour patterns and detect anomalous activities that may indicate insider threats. Here UK hospital electronic patient health record data set is used to conduct the experiments. The proposed approach comprises two key stages. In the initial stage, the unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model is utilized to find the abnormal patterns in the dataset and label each record in the dataset as normal or anomaly. The second stage involves different supervised classification algorithms namely SVM, KNN, DT, NB and RF are used to classify the new instance. The results demonstrate that the Random Forest (RF) achieves high accuracy in detecting insider threats with an accuracy of 99.97%. The findings of this research contribute to the field of healthcare data security by offering an intelligent and proactive solution for mitigating insider threats to cloud-based EHRs in Smart city environments.

articleTitle: Automated Shopping with RFID-Enhanced Smart Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Through the connection of commonplace objects, like smart grocery store equipment, the Internet of Things (IoT) is transforming daily life. Every object in this IoT application has an RFID tag attached to it. RFID-enabled smart shopping carts register items automatically, saving time and hassle by doing away with paper paperwork. Smart shelf integration with RFID readers also makes it easier to track inventory in real time and update servers centrally. The system's advantages include simple product administration and the ability to change operations via RFID scanning. This study shows how to design, build a functional model, and set up a safe communication channel to confirm that this wise purchase is feasible.

Author Keywords: RFID Reader and Tag Automated billing

articleTitle: Real-Time Anomaly Detection Without False Positives Using Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research work addresses the growing significance of Anomaly Detection Systems (IDSs) in ensuring the security of digital systems and networks. The inherent challenge in distinguishing genuine anomalies from benign variations in network traffic demands considerable time and effort from analysts. To address this issue, the study proposes a novel approach that integrates Genetic Algorithm (GA) with machine learning and data mining technologies for real-time anomaly detection with a focus on minimizing false positives. The methodology involves using the genetic algorithm to evolve decision tree-based rules that encapsulate the characteristics of anomalies, enabling the system to autonomously discern between normal and aberrant behavior. By incorporating these rules into the genetic algorithm, the system gains the capability to proactively prevent identified anomalies, going beyond mere detection to actively mitigate potential threats. The research methodology includes creating a diverse dataset representative of network activities and anomalies, iteratively refining decision tree rules through the genetic algorithm, and evaluating the resulting model in real-time scenarios. The innovative amalgamation of genetic algorithms with decision tree-based classification offers a promising avenue for enhancing the efficiency and reliability of IDSs, with potential implications for the broader field of cybersecurity by providing a proactive defense mechanism against network anomalies and fortifying the resilience of digital infrastructures.

articleTitle: AI Based Banking Data Analysis with a Design Thinking Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Banks serve as intermediary organizations for investors and lenders. After receiving deposits from both normal persons and companies, they lend the funds to borrowers, individuals, companies, and governments. This intermediation process ensures that savings are channeled efficiently into productive investments, contributing to our country economic growth. According to developments in general information analysis and technology, the banking sector has increasing an enormous transformation in recent years. Machine learning technologies have emerged as powerful tools for predictive analytics and get the perfect decision-making in this field. This study displays the use of machine learning technologies for performing predictive analytics in bank sector, focusing on various use cases. The main objective of this research is to demonstrate the potential of machine learning to improve decision-making processes in different banking sectors.

articleTitle: Gesture Guide: Empowering Deaf and Mute Individuals with ISL Recognition and Guidance System using Hand signs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Indian Sign Language (ISL) is a crucial language used by the deaf and mute community. The paper presents a systematic approach that utilizes Indian Sign Language video as input and converts it into text. By leveraging support vector machines, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, Media Pipe, and deep learning methods, the proposed system effectively addresses the challenges faced by the deaf and mute community in accessing educational resources and engaging in daily activities. The approach takes a step-by-step, methodical approach to improve the efficiency and accuracy of hand gesture recognition, enhancing accessibility and inclusion for the deaf and mute community.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring and Remote Pipeline Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: By incorporating cutting-edge technologies for more robust, sustainable, and effective urban water systems, a smart water grid revolutionizes the management of water resources. The main goals, elements, advantages, and difficulties of smart water networks are covered in this synopsis. These grids maximize water supply, minimize waste, and manage environmental consequences through the use of sensors, real-time analytics, and networked infrastructure. AI, IoT devices, sensor networks, data analytics, and remote monitoring are some of the components. Proactive leak detection, water conservation, and enhanced resource management are made possible by the system. Although they come with drawbacks like exorbitant costs and worries about data security, smart water networks can improve climate resilience, facilitate demand forecasting, and engage customers.

articleTitle: GUI Based Heart Disease Prediction Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The heart is a vital part of the human body. A dysfunctional heart valve can affect other organs in the human body, such as the brain and kidneys. An early warning system for coronary heart disease could alert people about the risk of the condition even before they visit a hospital or undergo costly medical tests. This type of approach would assist more than just medical practitioners. Thus, this technology offers a means for predicting coronary heart disease. One such technique is the Naïve Bayesian method, which is used for mining the health data records.

articleTitle: Implementation of a Balancing Controller for A Humanoid Robot Driving Scooter
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: A two-wheel self-balancing robot is a technological advancement in robotics. During the last few years, research has gained momentum on self-balancing robots, two-wheel inverted pendulums. Without external control, a self-balancing robot would roll around the wheels' rotation axis and eventually fall. When the robot is driven in the right direction at the right speed, it will return to the right position. Despite this, the robot is naturally unstable. Robots tend to fall off their axis if their base or platform is unstable or unbalanced. The gyro chip provides the change in angle of the robot, so the PID controller can check the error in the angular position of the self-balancing robot's base. A microcontroller and sensor system are used to stabilize an unstable system based on such a control system. After the Kalman filter recognizes an error in the angle or speed, the Proportionality Integrative Derivative (PID) calculates the error and sends the corrected signal to the robot. An open-source robotic 3D platform is used for the virtual demonstration of the paper (GAZEBO) and Robotics Operated System (ROS) for the pre-build robotic packages. It can be used for a variety of purposes, including surveillance, transportation, and reducing accidents and traffic jams.

articleTitle: Soil Fertility Assessment Using Ensemble Methods in Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research work focuses on the development and comparison of soil fertility classification models based on Ensemble methods. This study utilizes machine learning based algorithms for analyzing and assessing the soil fertility levels, a vital feature in sustainable agriculture. The models are developed using three different Ensemble methods in MATLAB. The ensemble learning approach has ability of handling complex datasets. It provides very accurate anticipations. The research considers three factors viz. pH, Nitrogen concentration, and Phosphorous concentration for soil fertility classification. This work offers valuable visions into effectiveness of Ensemble techniques in soil fertility classification, providing a practical approach to farmers & agriculture practitioners for making informed decisions pertaining to soil management practices.

articleTitle: Predictive Maintenance of Power Transformers in Distribution Network with Energy Management Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The reliability and efficiency of the electrical grid network are obtained through proper maintenance of the power transformers. The advanced maintenance of the electrical grid is obtained through modern strategies to enhance the performance of the system. Power transformers are an important part of the electrical distribution systems. Failure of transformers leads to various constraints regarding service interferences with costly outrages. Traditional forms of maintenance rely on manual inspections on fixed timelines which is not able to detect the transformer degradation at early stages. Advanced predictive maintenance with energy management is obtained through deep learning techniques with hybrid optimization techniques. This includes Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN). This is done through various sensors and monitoring equipment placed in the distribution network. The extraction of spatial and temporal data from images is obtained through the CNN component. The hidden defects and abnormal functioning of various parts in the transformer are detected through CNN. Oil leakages, overheating and insulation failure are the early signs of transformer failures. The RNN component concentrates on the data generated by sensors and meters in real-time environment. This helps to predict the future demand for power transformers. The sequential patterns are obtained through the LS TM component. They provide accurate details regarding the performance and life of transformers. The integration of energy management with predictive maintenance helps optimise power utility while maintaining the reliable operation of transformers.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis on Blockchain Based Healthcare Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Blockchain generation has the capability to revolutionize the management and sharing of Electronic Medical Records (EMRs). By using a distributed ledger, blockchain can set up a steady document of transactions, making it a suitable solution for safeguarding the data from unauthorized data access and modification. One technique to leverage block chain for EHRs involves the utilization of SHA-256 algorithm. This cryptographic hash function allows the era of a unique identifier, known as a hash, for each information detail. When a brand new EHR is generated, its hash is calculated and saved at the blockchain, thereby setting up a steady and tamper-evidence record of the EHR. In the event that a EHR undergoes any unauthorized changes, its hash will trade accordingly. Consequently, any unauthorized alterations to the EHRmay be detected immediately. The emergence of the COVID-19 pandemic has underscored the critical need for privacy protection of individuals who test positive for the virus. However, the existing tracing systems face challenges such as privacy violations, potential leakage of sensitive information, and susceptibility to cyberattacks. This feature of block chain makes it an ultimate technique for making sure the integrity of EHRs.

articleTitle: IoT and AI Based Android App for Safety Assistance and Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Research suggests that a person may apply and use a smart phone to expedite daily chores. Nowadays, everyone everywhere needs safety assistance because of the increasing number of traffic-related deaths and injuries brought on by reckless driving, delayed medical attention, sexual harassment of women, child abduction, adventurous travel, crime, terrorism, health, natural disasters, and other related incidents. The primary cause of mortality is a lack of access to high-quality medical care. Appropriate communication and guidance mechanisms are needed to minimize these issues. The main objective of this work is to create a system that may effectively assist in averting any type of safety issue. In such cases, this proposed system provides an effective solution and alert the appropriate authorities and persons so that the issue may be resolved immediately. This initiative aims to combines Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IOT) to produce the most accurate recommendations for user's safety precautions and also to prevent and detect accidents. Utilizing machine learning methods, this study analyzes datasets created especially for the victim healthcare system. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Neural Network and Naïve Bayes are some of the methods used in this study to forecast the user's critical or non-critical information. And also using proposed stacked ensemble methods provide better accuracy compare with other machine learning models. When the training and testing datasets are split 70:30, the algorithm performs at its most accurate level. Based on experimental study, the suggested stacked ensemble approach outperforms previous methods in terms of prediction accuracy, with a maximum of 0.992.

articleTitle: A Secure Multi Factor Authentication Framework in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Computers perform a major role in our daily lives. To computerize the information in the form of data in order to make the data efficient and for a long time. As the size of the data increases, it is necessary to maintain that data securely and can make the data accessible for the user. In order to handle the process of request-response in an efficient manner in this technological world, we have to move on Cloud Computing. Cloud Computing, as the name indicates, the data being obtained is kept in the cloud space or some virtual storage. The data found in the cloud can be accessible from anywhere by the client. There exist several security mechanisms in order to protect the data in the cloud. This research work proposes a technique called Novel Enhanced Multi Factor Authentication (NE-MFA) to implement a secure authentication mechanism for the cloud data. The proposed NE-MFA has implemented the factors, system hardware credentials along with MAC and IP address to authenticate the cloud system to improve the security measures and authentication accuracy.

articleTitle: Automatic Fire Extinguishing System Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Fire accidents are the most dangerous and fatal accidents that occur as a result of worker negligence and inadequate supervision. The primary goal of this research work is put out the fire as quickly and effectively as possible. This project effectively extinguishes the fire by spraying water at that specific location, requiring less water than the traditional approach. The proposed design includes a flame sensor, a temperature sensor, and a gas sensor to determine whether a fire accident has happened. To do this, the sensors are positioned on top of a rotating platform that is connected to the servo motor. Due to this effective detection, the fire will be detected at an early stage and extinguished using the nozzle linked to the rotating base. All logical processes are performed by using Arduino. Furthermore, the fire activity can be monitored using IoT with the help of Blynk.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Outcomes of Tesseract OCR for Different Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Hindi and Gujarati are Devanagari scripts that have contributed to the culture of India in the form of literature and human interactions. Due to aging, the textually rich literature of these languages may not exist for future generations. To preserve them, the technological solution known as an optical character recognition engine is used. Tesseract OCR engine supports the conversion of Hindi and Gujarati language-based images to equivalent text outputs. Major challenge in generating better quality of text outputs is acquisition of high resolution and noise free images. This study has compared the working of the Tesseract OCR engine for the Gujarati and Hindi languages and determined how effective it is for real-time applications.

articleTitle: Fire Detection Using Image Processing in Industries
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Nowadays, fire in the workplace causes significant damage because it is not used early on due to a lack of awareness. As a result, all machines in the industry could be damaged. The most prevalent causes of fire include static electricity, overheating, error by humans, external factors, and mechanical failure. This study addresses concerns with existing solutions by incorporating functionality such as alert and detection. To get real-time detection results, the fire detection unit was created using PythonCV and an image processing model. To detect fire images, an image pre-processing technique called the Haar Cascade Classifier was used. The trained model was tested and compared with other cutting-edge methods. A big fire scale and negative photos of fire in various indoor and outdoor environments were used. The video camera has no specific requirements. The camera will keep monitoring the situation in the room as long as the device is powered ON. If the camera detects a fire, the image is evaluated using an image processing model, the buzzer sounds, and an alarm message is delivered to the user's smartphone via Email.

articleTitle: Fake Currency Detection using Inception V3
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Fake currency is an issue that causes considerable problems for financial institutions, enterprises andindividuals. Detecting fake currencies with high accuracy is important for the integrity of financial systems. Research describes a unique approach for detection of fake cash that uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The proposed system automatically detects the fake currencies using deep learning and computer vision techniques. CNN s are outstanding performers in variety of image classification tasks, makes it good alternative for currency authentication. The process starts with capturing high-resolution picture of the currencies using current image capture technologies like cameras or scanners. To extract features and quality of the image, the image is pre-processed. Guarantees the stability of the model in the face of changing environmental circumstances. The CNN scans the new images of banknote and assigns a probability score that indicates potential for genuineness. It is highly precise, can handle a wide range of currency denominations, and can adapt to new fakeing strategies as they appear. It reduces the need for manual inspection, lowering the danger of human error. In using Convolutional Neural Networks to detect fake currency is a viable solution to the persistent issues of protecting the integrity of financial institutions. With the use of this technology, banknote authentication procedures might become much more accurate and efficient, safeguarding the financial interests of both citizens and governments.

articleTitle: English Pronunciation Transformation Text Model Based on Decision Tree Pattern Recognition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: With the development of various technologies, the speech recognition system is gradually improved to meet the various requirements. In this study, the focus is on English pronunciation transformation text model based on decision tree and pattern recognition algorithm. In the proposed algorithm, 3 aspects are considered. Aspect 1: the decision tree algorithm is improved, this study considers the multivariate joint partitioning can improve the overall performance of the integrator by bringing more diverse individuals into the integrator, then the targeted normal form distance function is considered for the better distance measurement. Aspect 2: the speech signal features are designed to make the better signal classification. Aspect 3: the novel noise removal algorithm is proposed to make the audio-text transformation are efficient. In the experiment section, the accuracy is selected as the measurement and the models such as Neural Networks (NN) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) are considered. The accuracy of the proposed algorithm reaches more than 99% on average.

articleTitle: Energy Optimization in WSN Through Vacation Policy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: A Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) is a system of linked sensors that may wirelessly interact with one another to track changes in the environment or in the real world. It is made up of tiny, self-sufficient sensor nodes that are outfitted with a variety of sensors to monitor and gather environmental data. The kind of data that must be gathered and the particular application will determine which sensors are best. A vacation strategy has been suggested to lower WSN energy usage and extend the nodes' battery life. Theoretical analysis is supported by experimental data, confirming the effectiveness of our strategy in extending the lifespan of WSN.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Enhancement using Blending of Contrast Enhancement Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Underwater images are useful in research of marine biology, oceanography, environmental monitoring and archaeological survey. However, underwater images have low contrast and are harmed by factors such as light attenuation, colour distortion, etc. Hence, underwater image enhancement is used to overcome above challenges and enhance the low contrast images so that it can be used for further applications. This work employs a mixture of two or more methods for contrast enhancement.
