CLAHE is utilised in conjunction with contrast enhancement techniques including DSIHE, RSIHE, and BBHE Non-reference performance metrics such as entropy, UIQM, UCIQE are used to evaluate contrast enhancement techniques. In this study, contrast enhancement techniques are applied on 1150 Underwater images. These underwater images are taken from two underwater image dataset called UIEB and EUVP and then combination of Global HE based contrast enhancement technique with CLAHE is applied. The combination of RSIHE and CLAHE outperforms all other methods in both UIQM value 2.6238 and entropy with entropy value 7.9867. Compared to other contrast enhancement methods used in the study, RSIHE followed by CLAHE with value 0.6621 and DSIHE followed by CLAHE with value 0.6651 perform better in the case of UCIQE.

articleTitle: Smart Learning of Animals Using Virtual Reality Zoo
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: With its potential to completely change how people learn about the world, Virtual Reality (VR) is a rapidly emerging technology. VR may be used to create immersive and interactive experiences that let people to learn in a safe and regulated way about new settings and stimuli. This is especially useful when it comes to animal learning. A computer-generated environment, the VR zoo aims to replicate the feeling of going to a real zoo. Equipped with a virtual reality glass or Google cardboard, users can engage with the VR zoo by exploring various displays, observing various creatures, and gaining knowledge about their native environments. The application is tested with 20 students in the age group 6 to 10 and the feedback and outcome of the learning are found to be really high in terms of engagement and creating interest among them.

articleTitle: 2D Photonic-Crystal Hexagonal Resonator for Albumin Concentration Detection in Urine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In this work, a 2D photonic-crystal ring resonator for albumin concentration detection in urine is proposed. FDTD method is used for modeling this sensor. When the concentration of albumin in urine is changed, there is a change in refractive index (RI) of sensor holes in the resonator. When RI of holes are varied, there is wavelength shift in the transmission spectra of resonator. The change in albumin concentration in urine is measured as a change in resonant wavelength of sensor. The sensor provides a 117 nm/RIU of sensitivity and maximum Q- factor of 26144. The change in resonant wavelength is 0.15nm for the change in albumin concentration from 7-125mg/dl to 250-1000mg/dl.

articleTitle: 3D Simulation and Testing of Formation Flying Using ESPcopter
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research work intends to develop an algorithm for 3D simulation of formation flying using ESP-copter and successfully implementing it in real life environment. Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) flight is the coordinated movement of two or more UAVs, which are required to fly from one location to another while preserving the intended pattern, i.e., moving and maneuvering together in a controlled, timed, and prearranged manner. New methods are required to coordinate Unmanned Aerial Vehicles when they are flying without direct human supervision as their popularity and number rise daily. It is a difficult and time-consuming process that calls for more time, money, and study to test such methods on live UAVs. As a result, it becomes vital to simulate the solutions that have been designed first. The purpose of this paper is to simulate the algorithm of formation flight such that the swarm of UAVs collaborate as a team, rather than flying as an independent drone. Initial testing is performed via software-in-the-loop (SITL), demonstrating formation flight of three ESPcopter. Software such as ArduPilot, Mission Planner and Gazebo are used for the simulation of the formation flight algorithm.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing High Power Electronics: GaN-Based-TFET as the Next Frontier
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: As the demand for high-power electronics spans diverse industries, the pursuit of innovative semiconductor devices capable of meeting burgeoning power requirements becomes imperative. This article investigates the transformative capabilities of Gallium Nitride (GaN)-based Tunnel Field-Effect Transistors (TFETs) within the realm of high-power applications. GaN celebrated for its exceptional electrical properties, emerges as a promising contender poised to redefine the boundaries of power electronics. Leveraging a Tunnel Field-Effect Transistor design, distinguished by its unique tunnelling mechanism, these devices confer distinct advantages over traditional transistor technologies, including reduced leakage current and heightened energy efficiency. The simulation in this study aims to achieve an On-state current of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−8</sup>A and subthreshold swing (SS) of 56mV/dec with a fixed off-state current of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>A. This article delves into the pivotal features of GaN-based TFETs, emphasizing their applicability in high-power scenarios and their potential to revolutionize the power electronics landscape. By offering insights into the underlying principles and recent advancements in this technology, the article seeks to enhance understanding and position GaN-based TFETs as the next frontier in high-power electronic devices.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence on Visually Impaired People: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence has become a significant tool in modern technology, enabling people to interact with machines through various methods. Individuals with visual impairments have trouble doing tasks because they are either blind or have poor vision. BVI stands for Blind and Visually Impaired. Solutions must also advance with technology to ensure that individuals can effectively navigate their surroundings and assist them in real-time navigation. The study conducts surveys on visually challenged individuals in the community and aims to assist them by providing smart gadgets to identify faces, colours, and objects. Moreover, this study emphasizes more on different technologies and methods that are used earlier to help visually impaired people in their day-to-day life.

articleTitle: Investigation and Demonstration of Hybrid Passive Optical Networks for Smart City Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Nowadays., the FTTH (Fiber to the Home) technology is becoming more popular due to its high bandwidth., high data rate an d long reach communication. A Bidirectional Hybrid Passive Optical Networks (HPON) has been designed in this research study for enabling efficient data transmission. Bidirectional optical fiber works both for uplink and downlink transmission. Erbium Doped Fiber Amplifier offers a better efficiency. This study has also investigated that the Q-Factor is decreasing with the data rate and fiber length. Further., a large number of users can be connected by using this technology. Here., low power consumption plays a major role in smart city applications. For simulation and optimization purpose., OptiSystem software is used.

articleTitle: Implementation and Framework for Virtual Reality Integration in Real Estate Industry Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The advent of cutting-edge virtual reality (VR) technology has revolutionised the real estate market by providing fresh approaches to improving property deals. A thorough framework for virtual reality (VR) integration in the real estate industry is laid out in this paper. It covers all the bases, including property visualisation, virtual showings, home staging, exploring neighbourhoods, remote collaboration, marketing, analytics, compatibility, training, and ethics. This article presents a comprehensive overview of the many advantages of virtual reality (VR) adoption, including enhanced property visualisation, buyer engagement, and marketing success, by drawing on a study of relevant research, case studies, and best practises. (Nieradka, Piotr 2019) It goes into the difficulties and moral dilemmas that come with virtual reality (VR), offers advice on how to put VR into practise, and explains how to quantify VR's effect on property deals. By delving into upcoming developments, this study highlights how virtual reality (VR) might revolutionise the real estate market and provides suggestions on how lawmakers, industry players, and tech companies should promote the appropriate integration of VR.

articleTitle: Development of HR Metrics and Plans for Employee Engagement in Banking Sector Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The development of an economy is based upon the functioning of banking sectors. Employee engagement is an important tool for obtaining a productive base. This is obtained through a cutting-edge approach such as deep learning integrated with blockchain technology. The deep learning algorithms are used to analyze huge amounts of HR data. This results from performance reviews to employee feedback. This helps HR professionals in the banking sector to identify the recent trends and potential areas for the development of employee engagement. The integration of blockchain technology provides security and transparency in HR plans. This helps in increasing the data integrity and reducing the risk of unauthorized access. This is largely influenced in the banking sector because the information must be maintained confidentially. The deep learning algorithms are used to predict employee engagement levels based on historical data and real-time inputs. This helps the HR professionals can proactively implement targeted initiatives to enhance workplace satisfaction which helps in improving professional growth. The use of blockchain technology helps to obtain reliable information for performance evaluation. This helps to obtain the trust between the employees. Thus the proposed system provides a transparent approach to workforce management in a dynamic banking environment.

articleTitle: Design of UWB MIMO Antennas with Enhanced Isolation for Wearable Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)

authors.preferredName: Maddi Dharani Sai Sri Durga Manisha

abstract: This research work presents a wearable UWB-MIMO antenna consisting of two components and an inverted E-shaped stub that functions as a decoupling network. The decoupling structure provides an isolation of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$< -15\text{dB}$</tex> across the UWB. A wearable denim material is used as the substrate in the suggested layout, and an inverted E-shaped stub is used as a decoupling structure on the antenna's rear side with a partial ground to improve port isolation. The proposed UWB-MIMO, with dimensions of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$50\times 35\times 1.59\text{mm}^{3}$</tex>, is replicated to include the entire UWB frequency range. The suggested configuration exhibits a diversity gain (DG) exceeding 9.9 and an envelope coefficient of correlation (ECC) below 0.05 throughout the entire band. The antenna works well and is appropriate for wearable applications.

articleTitle: Visually Impaired Assistance Using Object, Distance and Face Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The proposed visually impaired assistance using object, distance, and face identification system aims to help visually impaired people. It uses facial recognition to assist people in identifying their friends and family, as well as object detection with distance estimator to detect potentially threatening objects that may approach them. If a person carrying an object is unfamiliar to the visually impaired, they will be warned. The proposed methodology increases the safety and security of visually impaired people while allowing them to recognize familiar faces. It is an advanced technique to enable people with visual impairments to navigate their surroundings securely and freely.

articleTitle: Demystifying the Underlying Multi-Faceted Dimensions of AI Usage Intention Among HEIs Students: A Conceptual Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) emerges as a common topic in our daily lives by capturing interest from all walks of life. The immersion of AI is not exclusive. It is widely gaining attention from business and non-business settings such as the education sector. Education is often regarded as the key to unlocking the potential future generation; hence AI usage and adoption shall be carefully considered with the proper guidelines and policies. The background calls for the need to develop a conceptual framework in examining the interplay of powerful technology with the multifaceted aspects of the learning process along with the relevant psychological aspects of the students on their intention to use AI in the academic context. This study reviews the existing literature to uncover the relevant theories to examine the interrelationship of AI concerning students' learning process. The framework that emerged serves as a guide for the future direction of the study in this domain.

articleTitle: Classification of Gastrointestinal Diseases from Endoscopic Images Using Convolutional Neural Network with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has the potential to revolutionize the field of gastrointestinal disease diagnosis by enabling the development of accurate and efficient automated systems. This study comprehensively investigates endoscopic image classification for gastrointestinal diseases using deep learning models. Gastrointestinal diseases are a significant healthcare concern worldwide, necessitating accurate diagnostic tools. The proposed architecture relies on the convolutional layers of pre-trained CNN networks (DenseNet121, EfficientNetB5, Xception, and ResNet50) for feature extraction with a newly designed fully connected layer and output layer to facilitate reliable intestinal disease classification. The primary goal is to improve clinical decision support to diagnose gastrointestinal diseases. The paper demonstrates the efficiency of these models in precisely categorizing gastrointestinal diseases through extensive evaluation using the KVASIR Dataset, which includes 4000 different types of intestinal images. The experimental results show that EfficientNetB5 achieved the highest testing accuracy of 92.58% and outperformed all networks trained using the proposed framework.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based System and Method of Autonomous Robots for Garbage Collection in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The emergence of smart cities signifies a paradigm shift in urban development, prioritizing efficiency, sustainability, and improved quality of life. This research study proposes an innovative approach to revolutionize the process of urban waste collection by leveraging the capabilities of the Internet of Things (IoT) and autonomous robotics. The integration of IoT technology with autonomous robots for urban waste collection is analyzed, enabling these robots to operate with increased efficiency by navigating smart cities, identifying, and collecting waste containers with minimal human intervention. Through a comprehensive review of existing literature, this study evaluates the current state of waste management in smart cities, emphasizing the need for smart solutions. This study reviews the complexities of IoT-based systems, highlighting the role of sensors, data analysis, and real-time monitoring.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Strategies to Detect Phishing Website
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed a substantial increase in website phishing attacks. Many researchers have developed software solutions to detect phishing websites, however it cannot detect these attacks completely. There were several minor challenges in identifying the fraudulent websites. Therefore, the most effective way to detect phishing websites is to incorporate machine learning algorithms into the attack detection process. This improves the overall accuracy of the project and allows for more efficient computation. Implementing machine learning algorithms can also help to overcome the challenges faced by the existing phishing attack detection models. The major purpose of this research is to use the dataset collected to train the ENASSEMBLE Machine Learning (ML) model to detect the phishing websites.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning in Assessing the Sugar Quality in Sugar Mills
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the field of sugar production, guaranteeing consistent quality is vital for both consumers and industries. The goal of this research is to establish models, based on machine learning, capable of classifying the produced sugar quality into 3 distinct classes viz. High, Low, and Medium. There are several parameters associated with the complex production process es of sugar Mill. The developed models will include the potential of machine learning techniques to speedily and precisely classify the sugar quality. To accomplish this, a secondary dataset based on numerous runs of sugar production has been used here to train and test two machine learning based models using the Decision Tree, and K-Means clustering techniques in MATLAB. The classification accuracy of both models has also been Investigated, The successful creation of machine learning based models for sugar quality classification within the sugar mill has substantial implications. By automation of classification process, impending defects or inconsistencies in sugar quality can be swiftly identified, enabling timely interventions for oprlmizing production process. This research provides noteworthy potential for overall sugar quality improvement, improving customer satisfaction, and reinforcing the competitivenes s of sugar industries in the market.

articleTitle: A Review on Smartphone Charger: Technologies and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Over 600 million people in India use smartphones at the moment as more people switch from feature phones to smartphones. In 2023, over a billion people in India are expected to use smartphones. It is predicted that 1.55 billion Indians will own smartphones by 2040. As more people acquire mobile phones and use them for longer periods of time, charging the smartphone become a prominent factor. The proportion of energy used to charge a cell phone is determined by several variables, including the phone's battery capacity, the charging technique, and the efficiency of the charging process. The method utilized for charging a phone also affects how much energy is used. Several kinds of mobile phone chargers that are available, energy-efficient charging methods, and energy costs related to smartphone usage are covered in this study.

articleTitle: Supervised Learning Approach for Detection Of Malicious Nodes
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Malicious node is one of the challenges faced by Sensors in IoT. Malicious node attacks a node by means of Denial of Service attack (DoS), and then drops the significant information forwarded by the neighbouring node. Overall performance of a network will be degraded by the malicious node. To detect malicious node, we applied concept of supervised learning called decision tree approach. Trusted node in a network will find the malicious node by calculating routing time of a node. Node with maximum routing time and minimum routing time will be detected as malicious node.

articleTitle: CNN and Edge-Based Segmentation for the Identification of Medicinal Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In Ayurveda, traditional and herbal medicine industries, it is of the utmost importance to precisely identify the appropriate medicinal plants used in the production of medicines. A medicinal plant's identity is determined by the shape, color, and texture of its leaves. SVM and KNN are existing Machine Learning (ML) models employed for this task; however, when it comes to identifying medicinal plants, they are ineffective. For medicinal plant identification, complex properties like leaf form, color, and texture can be difficult to accurately represent using traditional methods like KNN and SVM. In image recognition tasks, large datasets are common, and some approaches may not scale well under those circumstances. They might become prohibitively expensive to compute, rendering them useless for everyday use. The development of strong characteristics for plant recognition is frequently a time-consuming process, despite the fact that traditional models heavily rely on feature engineering. Hence, a promising approach to quickly identify the beneficial plant species is presented in this study. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is the solution proposed here to identify the medicinal plants. CNNs are appropriate for processing largescale data, for example, leaf structure, variety, and surface discovery, without requiring any prerequisite for broad element design due to their capacity to gain and concentrate requested qualities from the input images. CNNs are more adaptable to the real world because they can be trained effectively on large datasets and can be parallelized. When contrasted with different models, the one developed in this research study improves at characterizing the restorative plant.

articleTitle: Novel Plant Leaf Disease Detection Approach using Hybrid Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The early detection and identification of plant diseases are pivotal for precision agriculture, aiming to mitigate crop losses and optimize yields. This study presents a novel approach to plant disease identification, leveraging Deep Learning (DL) techniques with a focus on transfer learning. Traditional methods often rely on complex image enhancement, disease region segmentation, and feature extraction, whereas our approach employs Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for efficient and accurate disease detection. To enhance accessibility and diagnostic capabilities, we implement Hybrid DL Strategy, which consists of EfficientNetB0 and MobileNetV2 model, tailored for lightweight applications suitable for smartphone implementation. Efficient NetB0 model, which considers depth, width, and resolution during convolution, enhancing the model's capacity to capture intricate features critical for accurate disease diagnosis. The overall accuracy of proposed method is 98.44%, surpassing CNN, ResNet, and AlexNet. This high accuracy underscores the effectiveness of the proposed model in correctly classifying both diseased and healthy plant leaves.

articleTitle: Intrusion Detection Systems in VANET: A Review on Implementation Techniques and Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: With multiplying numbers of Automobiles, the complexity of Automobile industry has grown. Networked Automobiles in VANET (Vehicular Ad Hoc Network), keep posing challenges in many folds. The security of the Vehicular Network System is one of the prime challenges. There are many researches done and being undertaken to improve the efficiency of security systems to keep the network threats and attacks at bay, using many traditional and Machine learning techniques. The datasets also play a significant role in validating and implementing prototype Intrusion Detection System (IDS) Models. This research proposes in-depth study of security aspect of Vehicular Ad Hoc Network and available datasets. This work contributes towards helping enthusiast researchers to have a valuable knowledge of VANET, IDS, datasets, implementation methods, list of metrics and so on. Also suggests further challenges and future trends in VANET.

articleTitle: Ethical Considerations in Explainable AI: Balancing Transparency and User Privacy in English Language-based Virtual Assistants
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: English Language-Based Virtual Assistants (ELB-VAs) are AI-powered systems designed to comprehend and respond to user queries in the English language, exemplified by virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa. The need for balancing transparency and user privacy in ELB-VAs is paramount due to their pervasive integration into daily life. Ensuring transparency imbues user trust, while safeguarding privacy addresses ethical concerns associated with personal data. Existing methods involve clear privacy policies, user-controlled data sharing settings, and encryption. However, drawbacks include user confusion and potential biases. To address these limitations, this study proposes a novel approach. Methodologically, it integrates pre-processing techniques such as lowercasing and tokenization, coupled with a Natural Language Understanding model. This model undergoes intent and entity recognition training, enhancing accuracy, and incorporates privacy-aware response generation, ensuring informative yet privacy-conscious interactions. The implementation of the study's results is carried out using Python tools, showcasing improved metrics and response times. This approach contributes to a more transparent and privacy-respecting user experience, aligning with evolving ethical norms and setting the stage for advancements in ELB-VA technology. This comprehensive exploration bridges existing gaps, emphasizing the ethical imperative of user-centric and privacy-aware AI interactions in ELB- VAs. The proposed NLU model exhibits a substantial increase in accuracy compared to other methods, with an impressive accuracy value of 99.1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>• On average, it outperforms the Random Forest and Decision Tree models by 15.7 percentage points, highlighting its superior predictive capabilities in the evaluated task. This comprehensive exploration aligns with evolving ethical norms and establishes a foundation for future advancements in ELB-VA technology.

articleTitle: Hybrid Approach for Multi-Classification of News Documents Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the context of news articles, text classification is essential for organizing and retrieving useful information from massive amounts of textual data. Effectively categorizing news titles has gotten more challenging due to the development of online news outlets and the ongoing production of news. A multi-text classification technique primarily targeted at news titles is shown. The suggested approach automates the classification of news titles into predetermined classes or subjects by combining deep learning approaches and natural language processing (NLP) algorithms. Data preprocessing, which includes text normalization, tokenization, and feature extraction, is the first step in the procedure. This prepares the raw news titles for deep learning models.

articleTitle: A Novel Electronic Wheel Chair Design using Artificial Intelligence Assisted Smart Sensors and Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research work introduces a design paradigm for an electronic wheelchair, incorporating Artificial Intelligence (AI) assisted smart sensors and controllers to enhance overall functionality and user experience. Core components include advanced sensors for environmental and health data, an intelligent controller driven by AI algorithms, and motorized wheels for achieving seamless mobility. The smart sensors, spanning temperature, ECG, oxygen, and heart rate sensors, contribute to real-time health monitoring and environmental awareness. The AI-assisted controller optimizes wheelchair navigation, providing a responsive and adaptive system. Comparative performance metrics reveal the proposed design's superiority over traditional control methods, demonstrating heightened precision, sensitivity, specificity, and an impressive overall accuracy. User feedback corroborates the success of this innovative design, attaining high ratings for ease of use, health monitoring capabilities, overall comfort, and higher accuracy. This work outlines a transformative approach to electronic wheelchair design, emphasizing cutting-edge technologies to address user needs, enhancing performance standards, and redefine the landscape of mobility assistance and proposed DNN model achieved an accuracy of 0.97.

articleTitle: Enhanced Quantifying Assessment Model for Monetary Implication and Security in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the near future, businesses are going to struggle if secure information procedures and technologies are incorporated in the cloud computing platforms. Potential consumers such as the heads of information security require a way to consider the benefits and drawbacks of posting data security procedures and technologies within platforms that use cloud computing. The provision of services that are hosted, such as computer software, hardware, and storage, via the world's largest network is known as the cloud computing. Because of its quick implementation, adaptability, low beginning expenses, and the use of cloud computing has recently become almost commonly utilized by businesses of all categories, frequently as an integral part of hybrid or multi-cloud infrastructure frameworks. This study recommends employing the Petrinet technique for investigating work-flow security in cloud computing systems, identify potentially damaging exertion, as well as investigate malfunctions and undetected executions. The technology, regulations, instructions, and offerings that shield cloud infrastructure, the information, and apps against dangers are collectively referred to as cloud security.

articleTitle: State-of-the-Art of Voice Assistance Technology, Mitigating Replay Attacks: A Comprehensive Discussion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In recent years, smart home assistants have become increasingly popular among consumers worldwide. These intelligent devices, powered by artificial intelligence and voice recognition technology, Smart home assistants bring convenience and effectiveness to handling daily activities and overseeing different aspects of our residences. Nevertheless, the expanding use of these assistants raises apprehensions regarding security and privacy due to heightened connectivity and data gathering capabilities. The intensity of security threats associated with these devices is alarming. Specifically, security concerns regarding replay attacks have emerged as a critical challenge. While various strategies have been proposed by researchers in this domain, there is a need for more robust mechanisms. This research paper proposes a novel approach to mitigate replay attacks by combining nonce numbers and timestamps. The proposed use of timestamp and nonce number methods in preventing replay attacks in smart home assistants is highly promising. The proposed solution enhances the security of voice commands transmitted between the user and the smart home assistant. By introducing unique nonce numbers and timestamps in the communication protocol, the system effectively detects and prevents the replaying of previously recorded commands.

articleTitle: Nivaran-Blockchain Based FIR System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In the era of rapid technological advancements and evolving law enforcement agency requirements, the adoption of blockchain technology has emerged as a transformative approach to enhance the First Information Report (FIR) complaint system. In India, the incidence of criminal activities is on the rise, with many going undisclosed. Despite the availability of an online platform for maintaining FIRs and NCRs, the prevailing practice involves manually writing the majority of FIRs. Typically, a complainant must physically be present at the police station to report a legally punishable crime. While the Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems (CCTNS) introduced in 2009 has been a successful nationwide e-governance system, it remains state-specific and centralized. Therefore, the necessity for a fully decentralized system arises to eliminate a single point of failure, ensuring secure and confidential handling of complaints. The aim is to propose a blockchain-based complaint management system for both cognizable and non-cognizable offenses. In this proposed system, the police report undergoes hashing, encryption, and inclusion in the blockchain network, with storage in the InterPlanetary File System (IPFS). The blockchain captures the complaint and its timestamp, providing substantial evidence in cases where the police may decline to file a formal complaint or acknowledge receipt. This approach mitigates the risk of tampering or non-reporting of FIR/NCR records, as all data is stored in an immutable database.

articleTitle: The Impact of 5G Technology on Agile Project Management: A Cross-Industry Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Project management and organisation are completely transformed by the introduction of 5G technology, which has brought in a new era of connection. This research investigates how 5G networks will affect Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Agile Project Management (APM) and the larger context of the Technology-Organization-Environment (TOE) paradigm through a cross-industry examination. Agile approaches may benefit from improved adaptive design, cooperation and connectivity as a result of 5G technology being included into project management procedures. A team of developers can work together more easily and make decisions more quickly with the real-time data transfer made possible by 5G networks' higher capacity and speed. This study looks at how Agile methods for managing projects are more effective and flexible when using 5G's low latency and high data throughput. This research explores how Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems may be affected by 5G. With 5G networks' enhanced capabilities, current information synchronisation is made possible in new ways, enabling ERP systems to function with increased precision and speed. This study investigates how supply chain administration, resource allocation and general organisational agility are improved by 5G-enabled ERP. This study evaluates how various sectors' organisational structures, procedures, and objectives are affected by the deployment of 5G infrastructure. This research outlines critical elements that influence the successful implementation of 5G into project management and ERP systems, including technology preparedness, organisational culture, and external factors. This research provides important insights into the potential for transformation of 5G technology through a thorough cross-industry assessment. It also gives organisations an established basis on which to adapt their Agile Project Management and Enterprise Resource Planning practises in the dynamic context of today's digital world.

articleTitle: PlantLDNet : Disease Detection in Leaf Images Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Automated disease diagnosis in the agricultural field has benefited from the recent advances in big data, deep learning, and computer vision across a wide range of applications. However, intelligent disease prediction is crucial for safely maintaining a good agricultural production. Moreover, unclear disease prognosis is caused by the degree of leaf disease inhomogeneity, the complexity of the background-which includes the low contrast with the surrounding area and the potential for shadows with a similar intensity. This research provides a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model called PlantLDNet that has hyperparameters configured optimum to distinguish between leaf images showing disease and those without it, hence avoiding the problems associated with vanishing gradient. A comparative study of the proposed custom CNN model PlantLDNet and earlier research works was conducted using the following metrics: precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, loss accuracy, receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves, and Area Under Curve (AUC) measure. The comparison findings show that the proposed PlantLDNet model has the highest classification prediction effectiveness (99.85%) with less computational complexity. It also has an elevated high F1-score of 93% when trained for Early Bright, 98% for Healthy, and 92% for Late Bright.

articleTitle: Modified BIRCH and Hybrid Deep Framework for Tomato Leaf Disease Segmentation and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Identifying disease at an early stage contribute s to improving productivity and quality of crops. Farmer's misidentification can lead to ineffective treatment strategy, adversely impacting tomato plants and agriculture. In this work, a MBIRCH algorithm is introduced for segmenting process along with hybrid model for classification process. Preprocessing, segmentation, extraction of features and classification are the four processing steps for categorizing leaf diseases on tomato crop. The input image is primarily under preprocessing, median filter is utilized in this stage. Consequently, the obtained image after preprocessing is fed to segmentation stage, where MBIRCH framework is introduced for proper segmentation process. Then various features, including MBP, GLCM, and shape -based features, are extracted from the segmented outcome. Finally, the hybrid classification system, which is a combination of BiLSTM and CNN, receives the obtained features as input. The hybrid model classifies tomato leaf diseases by calculating the averag e output of two classifiers. The classified tomato leaf diseases include bacterial spot, early blight, late blight, leaf mold, septoria leaf spot, two-spotted spider mite, target spot, tomat o mosaic viral, and tomato yellow leaf curl viral.

articleTitle: A Survey on Breast Cancer Detection Using Computational Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Breast cancer accounts for around 25% of all female cancers, making it the most common type of cancer. Breast cancer survival rates can be improved with early detection and diagnosis. However, personalized recommendations for breast cancer diagnosis are frequently insufficient, resulting in missing possibilities for early detection. Another factor is that breast cancer screening and diagnostic tests can be costly and time-consuming. This study intends to make a paradigm shift in the fight against breast cancer by identifying customized treatment, enhancing diagnostic processes, and influencing patients with knowledge by ultimately contributing to higher survival rates. The proposed approach aims to empower individuals and solve the problems associated with late-stage breast cancer diagnoses by analyzing the potential risk factors.

articleTitle: Intelligent Transportation System for Sustainable and Efficient Urban Mobility Traffic Flow Prediction Using Optimized Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Traffic blockage is described as the transport system's condition, characterized by the automobiles' low speed. It is also because of roads, climatic conditions, particular zones, temperature, the number of events on that day etc. It mainly happens in metropolitan cities. Due to the development of communication technology, most organizations have transferred their conventional methods to computing methods. The primary objective of this study is to investigate deep learning algorithms that can efficiently capture the inherent relationships present in network traffic flows, thereby facilitating precise predictions. To evaluate the precision and predictive potential of these approaches, two initial baseline models are constructed utilizing Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) models. These baseline models make predictions for target values' mean and mode, drawing from the training data. A model is considered accurate and proficient if it surpasses the basic, naive benchmarks established based on predefined performance metrics. The optimization process, relying on Red Fox (RF), is determined through a quantitative analysis employing well-established evaluation criteria commonly used in supervised deep learning, including accuracy, precision, recall, Mean Squared Error (MSE), and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE).

articleTitle: Smart Energy: Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Charging and Battery Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Recent years have witnessed the extensive use of AI in various sectors. The power sector is not an exception to it From mobile phones to wearables and from home UPS to green energy grids, batteries are used everywhere. Hence, AI can be used to improve the efficiency of batteries. This study explores the applications, algorithms, and optimization methods that have been developed in this dynamic area. Unparalleled efficiency, sustainability, and grid reliability improvements can be achieved by integrating AI technologies with smart charging and battery management. This research study aims to present an understanding of the basic principles of smart charging and battery management and their role in developing the energy landscape. Also, this study provides a detailed analysis of AI applications in different devices, such as electric vehicles, renewable energy integration, portable electronics and energy storage systems in microgrids. Finally, this study analyzes the real-world cases and successful implementations to assess the practical benefits and capabilities of AI-driven solutions. Along with many benefits, there are various limitations and addressing those is very important to enhance safety, reliability, and environmental sustainability.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Energy Management: The Integration of Progressive Technology and Competitive Power Market for Interconnected Multi-Smart System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The idea behind revolutionizing energy management is to use cutting-edge technology and systems to replace the conventional approaches to energy management. The goal of this strategy is to develop intelligent, networked energy systems that can effectively track and manage energy use across a range of settings. Technology integrations such CT/PT, PIC controller, relay, load current, LCD, and IOT provide real-time data analysis and decision-making to improve energy use. This lowers costs while simultaneously ensuring a steady and long-lasting supply of energy. Through this idea, businesses and people may cut operating expenses while also doing their part to lessen the carbon imprint. Revolutionizing Energy Management offers the possibility of cost savings and sustainable energy management, as well as improved integration and administration of renewable energy sources. This idea provides a way to efficiently integrate and use renewable energy sources in the current energy system in light of the growing push toward renewable energy. It creates the foundation for a more effective and environmentally sustainable energy system by automating and improving the energy production and consumption processes. Additionally, it assists in identifying possible problems and enhancing the entire energy management infrastructure with the use of data analytics and predictive maintenance. Finally, Revolutionizing Energy Management is an innovative idea that has the potential to alleviate the world's energy concerns and lead us toward a cleaner, more sustainable future.

articleTitle: IoT Based Forest Fire Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques- A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Real hazards to infrastructure, environmental systems, and human life come from forest fires. According to a survey, forest fire will damage the forest to a half by 2030. Forest fire can be prevented by taking actions by having fire detection devices. Most of the institutions and research development centers are attracted towards the fire detection systems. There are many sensors for detecting the fire but it also has many demerits like expensive, requires large space for installation and other problems. Due to the emergence of a digital camera, detection of fire has become easier. The use of sensors has many limitations but it is resolved by using image processing techniques. Because certain things share characteristics with fire, making accurate forest fire detection algorithms difficult, false alert rates may be significant. In this study, we may examine several ways for detecting forest fires and provide a brand-new, four-stage video-based method for detecting forest fires using image processing. To find moving areas, a background-subtraction technique is used first. Secondly, RGB color space is used to identify possible fire zones. Third, because candidate zone might have moving fire-like things, extraction of characteristics is employed to differentiate between the actual fire as well as fire-like items. The category of the fire can be determined by using the convolutional neural network method. Further incorporate devices for fire detection alerts into this system.

articleTitle: Self Sufficient Charging Control System for Electric Bicycle Application
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Electric bicycles are currently a global trend, and our project aims to be at the forefront of pioneering this technology. The establishment of an electric bicycle system is our initial focus, with a commitment to simplicity and independence. Central to this initiative is the integration of a Brushless Direct Current BLDC motor seamlessly into the front wheel, serving as into electrical energy through a voltage booster circuit, efficiently meeting the battery's requirements. This innovative power regeneration system not only amplifies efficiency but also extends the bicycle's range, positioning it as a sustainable mode of transport. Our ongoing focus revolves around optimizing the front wheel setup with a generator, aiming for seamless integration to further enhance the overall riding experience. The implementation of Blynk Internet of Things (IoT) technology for real- time monitoring of energy generation through mobile devices completes our vision of promoting a greener urban transit system. a core component to enhance energy efficiency and extend the bicycle's range while maintaining aerodynamic integrity. The primary rear- wheel motor serves a dual purpose by propelling the electric bicycle and charging the battery. Simultaneously, the front wheel contributes by generating power and converting kinetic energy

articleTitle: A Secure Wireless Communication in Vehicular Ad-Hoc Network System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Ensuring the confidentiality and integrity of communication is an essential aspect of Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs), where vehicles communicate wirelessly to enhance road safety and traffic efficiency. VANETs present distinct security challenges due to their dynamic nature, open communication environment, and susceptibility to malicious attacks. Diverse security solutions are employed to address these concerns. Cryptographic protocols play a crucial role in ensuring the security of VANET connections. Digital signatures and encryption ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data. Authentication mechanisms are employed to verify the authenticity of communications exchanged between vehicles, hence restricting unwanted access and malicious activities. Ensuring privacy is of utmost importance in VANETs, and measures are taken to safeguard the identities of vehicles and their users. Utilizing pseudonym shifting strategies, cars periodically assume temporary identities to effectively deter prolonged vehicle surveillance. Secure message authentication ensures that the information exchanged between vehicles remains unaltered, hence enhancing the overall integrity of the data. Intrusion detection systems play a crucial role in the real-time monitoring of VANETs. These systems rapidly identify and react to malicious activities or breaches in security. Collaborative methods, wherein cars cooperate to identify and communicate irregularities, enhance the overall security status of the network. Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) have the potential to establish a dependable and credible communication environment by incorporating the following security characteristics. Consequently, this promotes enhanced driving safety, improved traffic control, and the maximum utilization of linked and autonomous vehicles in contemporary transportation networks.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Development of Human Emotion Detection based on Facial Features using Digital Image Processing Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research introduces the Human Emotion Detection utilizing Facial Features (HEDFF) framework, presenting a comprehensive and advanced approach to emotion analysis. Focused on the integration of the AffectNet dataset, renowned for its diversity in annotated facial expressions, our methodology employs digital image processing techniques. Gabor filtering enhances relevant features crucial for subsequent analysis, followed by Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) utilization for robust feature extraction. The EfficientNet architecture refines emotion classification, optimizing efficiency. The AffectNet dataset serves as a cornerstone for model training and evaluation, contributing to the framework's efficacy. Gabor filtering during data preprocessing emphasizes critical textures. The CNN architecture captures intricate facial features, and EfficientNet optimizes classification efficiency. Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) fine-tunes hyperparameters, enhancing the overall model performance. Rigorous evaluations against existing benchmarks showcase promising results in accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, with an outstanding overall accuracy of 98.87%. This research makes a significant contribution to the evolving landscape of emotion detection, providing a robust and efficient framework applicable across diverse domains. From human-computer interaction to mental health assessments, the proposed methodology demonstrates its versatility.

articleTitle: Urbansafeguard: A Comprehensive Smart Streetlight Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: With the increasing demand for safer urban environments, this project introduces a Smart Street Lighting System designed to enhance both safety and energy efficiency. The system integrates infrared (IR) motion sensors for adaptive street lighting and sound sensors for intelligent accident detection. When motion is detected, the system activates the street lights, ensuring well-lit pathways for pedestrians and drivers. In the event of a potential accident, the sound sensor is triggered to assess the sound level. If the sound surpasses a predefined threshold, a camera captures a photo, and an alert notification with the image is sent to a designated email address. This innovative approach not only contributes to sustainable urban development through energy-efficient lighting but also addresses the critical need for prompt accident detection and reporting in public spaces. The paper details the hardware and software components, presents experimental results, and discusses the system's impact on urban safety.

articleTitle: Small Sample Algorithm Optimization for Large Language Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: ChatGPT has sparked significant interest as the latest large language model due to its impressive logical coherence and robust interactive capabilities, allowing it to engage in natural conversations and deliver top-notch services. However, traditional self-attention mechanisms struggle with contextual information processing, relying on prior or posterior context. XLN et addresses this limitation by randomizing input sequences, enabling the model to capture contextual information comprehensively. As a result, XLNet, which leverages a Transformer decoder with an efficient global information-capturing attention mechanism, is the preferred model architecture for this purpose. Furthermore, this study has developed a novel incremental data dimensionality reduction module called IDPCA, taking advantage of PCA benefits, to optimize data dimensionality reduction tasks. Meta-learning is also utilized to fine-tune the small sample algorithm optimization. In experiments, the massive data anomaly detection scenario is considered, with Fl-Score as the evaluation metric. The results show that the proposed optimized model has achieved a better performance.

articleTitle: A Review of Cloud Computing Innovations for Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Cloud computing is the practice of offering services like servers, storage, analytics, and databases to networks or computer systems worldwide. With enhanced technical infrastructure, Internet users can now use computing frameworks with real-time applications through the web on their devices. Importance of the need for Educational Institutions to shift to Cloud computing-based real-time applications, which would facilitate better learning environments for students. This research study discussed about the advantages, disadvantages, and essential impacts on students' learning curves. Applications like the learning management system and weighed importance are mainly focused in this research study. The fundamental unit of learning needed for the current age of education that can use cloud computing would face network responsiveness, and the readiness of the various tools is discussed in this review article.

articleTitle: Enhancing Natural Language Processing in Multilingual Chatbots for Cross-Cultural Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: In order to promote smooth cross-cultural communication, this research focuses on improving Natural Language Processing (NLP) features within multilingual Chabots. The need for efficient communication across various linguistic and cultural barriers has grown as the world becomes more interconnected. In this context, multilingual Chabot's are essential tools that facilitate easy communication between users of various cultural backgrounds. In order to better understand and respond to a wide range of linguistic details, idioms, and cultural allusions, the research explores ways to improve NLP algorithms. This research investigates how machine learning techniques can be integrated to improve the Chabot's ability to adapt to various linguistic patterns, enabling it to acquire new language skills over time. By implementing an extensive and flexible approach, the proposed approach seeks to transform Natural Language Processing in Multilingual Chatbots for Cross-Cultural Communication. In order to identify language-specific patterns and specifications, the methodology starts with the collection of a diverse dataset that is representative of linguistic variations and cultural contexts. It then uses advanced linguistic analysis techniques like phonetic analysis. The next step is cultural context modelling, which entails building a database enhanced with cultural allusions and language variations unique to a given context that are obtained from various sources. Transfer learning, reinforcement learning for dialogue, and modern algorithms such as Multilingual Unsupervised and Supervised Embeddings (MUSE) for cross-lingual embeddings are all included in machine learning integration. In order to obtain information about language precision and cultural sensitivity, the methodology incorporates interactive surveys and sentiment analysis into a strong user feedback mechanism. The proposed model achieved 98% performance.

articleTitle: Wave & Play: Hand Gestures Redefining User Experience
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Technology interactions have been revolutionized by the major transformation of user interfaces brought about by the inclusion of hand gestures. The broad applications of hand gesture technologies in gaming, virtual reality, healthcare, automotive, and other fields are examined in this study. The fundamental technology underlying hand gesture detection is highlighted, with particular attention paid to its accuracy and adaptability. The discourse explores the benefits of hand gestures, highlighting their greater accessibility and intuitiveness through the use of user feedback and empirical research. Notwithstanding, certain obstacles and constraints, like concerns about privacy and accuracy, are carefully considered. The study examines potential developments and trends in hand gesture technology, with a focus on artificial intelligence and machine learning. The significance of responsible design and use is emphasized by highlighting ethical considerations in hand gesture interfaces. Moreover, difficulties arise from users' hands changing shape and speed during dynamic motions. Implementing a deep learning-based gesture-spotting algorithm that can identify the beginning and finish of a sequence of gestures inside a continuous data system is one suggested solution to this problem.

articleTitle: ChatWhiz: Chatbot Built Using Transformers and Gradio Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The project “ChatWhiz: Chabot built using Transformers, and Gradio Framework” endeavors to develop an advanced and versatile Chabot system employing advanced transformer models. The objective is to craft a potent and adaptable chatbot solution that enriches user experiences and delivers practical benefits to businesses and organizations across various domains, from customer service to e-commerce. This project seeks to create a versatile and intelligent chatbot for the education sector, utilizing cutting-edge machine-learning models and frameworks to enhance student engagement, education management, and information dissemination. The chatbot is designed to provide a broad spectrum of functionalities, including curriculum-based content understanding, text summarization, text auto-completion, text generation, and interactive assessments. Leveraging these capabilities aims to offer users a seamless and efficient educational experience.

articleTitle: Raspberry Pi-Enhanced Intrusion Detection System with Messenger API Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The study proposes a unique Intrusion Detection System (IDS) that makes use of the Raspberry Pi and messenger application programming interface (API) integration. Increasing cyber threats and the limitations of traditional detection methods necessitate the development of novel IDS system. Existing systems have limitations like poor reaction times, false positives, and less accuracy. In response, the proposed method makes use of the small but powerful Raspberry Pi network, which enhances efficiency of IDS system at low cost. Telegram messenger integration enables real-time alerts, ensuring users receive timely updates. The system proved excellent performance in detecting and mitigating various intrusion attempts in extensive experimentation and analysis. The system's effectiveness was demonstrated by a considerable reduction in false positives, an improved reaction time and accuracy. The combination of Raspberry Pi and Telegram messenger overcomes not only the inadequacies of traditional intrusion detection systems but also provides a cost-effective and accessible solution for small-scale applications, increasing the adoption of sophisticated security measures in a variety of situations.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Detection using RF Resonator in 5G Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This work presents a new approach for detecting early breast cancer using a bow tie antenna structure integrated on an “FR4” substrate and incorporating meta material concepts. The high-precision antenna was developed using CS T Studio Suite and PCB manufacturing technology. Optimized substrates in the 1.635 to 1.637 mm range complements antenna designs and improves overall performance. In particular, this antenna investigates the dielectric properties of breast tissue, which are important for distinguishing between benign and malignant abnormalities. A frequency selective surface (FSS) on the back of the antenna increases gain, and its bowtie configuration holds promise for detecting subtle abnormalities that indicate early breast cancer. The proposed design achieves improved bandwidth from 3.4 to 9 GHz (S11 > 10 dB) and peak gain of 6.2 dBi at 5 GHz with a meta material-based design. The surface current at 6.59GHz been noted as 25 amperes per meter. Specific abs orption rate (SAR) studies using a realistic hemis pherical breast phantom model demonstrate compliance with international safety limits over an average of 10 g of tissue. This fusion of meta materials and antenna design combined with dielectric analysis of tissues has great potential to significantly improve the sensitivity and specificity of detection methods and revolutionize early breast cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Comparative Methods of Implementation for Different Question Answering Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research introduces an innovative Question Answering (QA) system tailored explicitly for government department inquiries regarding individuals. Harnessing the prowess of cutting-edge language models such as BERT and T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer), the system excels in understanding complex queries within diverse governmental domains. Moreover, it incorporates a specialized Knowledge Graph meticulously curated with interconnected information about people across various departments. By integrating BERT and T5 for versatile query comprehension and answer generation alongside a comprehensive People-centric Knowledge Graph, this system aims to revolutionize information retrieval within government entities. The seamless fusion of these technologies promises accurate, contextually rich responses, optimizing operational efficiency across government departments and fostering streamlined access to crucial information.

articleTitle: Survey on Traffic Violation Prediction using Deep Learning Based on Helmets with Number Plate Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Nowadays, the most widely used mode of transportation is two-wheelers. Both bike riders and pillions are strongly encouraged to wear helmet. A significant application and developing field of study in machine learning and image processing, object tracking in video surveillance is of considerable interest to many academics. Object detection is the process of identifying the existence of items in a scene using a bounding box and the types or categories of the objects that have been placed. This study reviews tracking methods, classifies them into several sorts, and emphasizes the most significant and practical methods. Finally, this study analyzes potential study directions after reviewing general tactics as a part of the literature review on various approaches. This study uses an image processing system to identify motorcycle riders without helmets. Additionally, utilize the OCR method to extract user information from images of license plates and classify them using OCR. then figure out the fine amount. Making SMS services inform customers in order to avoid motor-bike accidents is the final step. The performance of the proposed framework is assessed in terms of precision and speed.

articleTitle: Adaptive Strategies for Scalable and Heterogeneous VANET Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Despite technological advancements, Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) continue to face challenges related to reliability and high-speed mobility. This study focuses on enhancing scalability, improving mobility, and addressing network heterogeneity in the context of data dissemination. Data dissemination involves the distribution or transmission of statistical data to users. Tools like NS3, SUMO utilizing OSM for realistic traffic simulations, MATLAB for Data Analysis and evaluation of various protocols like ADHOC, Dynamic Source Routing (DSR), Optimized Link State Routing Protocol (OLSR), Destination Sequenced Distance Vector Routing (DSDV). The research aimed to refine VANET simulations for effective decision making, as its primary objective data dissemination i.e. distribution or transmission of statistical data to users, forming the central focus of this investigation.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Stock Market Prediction System using Intelligent Learning Scheme with Data Processing Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The Stock Market Prediction System using Intelligent Learning Scheme (SMS-ILS) presented in this study integrates advanced methodologies to enhance the accuracy and reliability of stock market predictions. The system encompasses a preprocessing phase, addressing missing data and outliers, followed by feature extraction utilizing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) to capture intricate temporal dependencies. A Deep Belief Network (DBN) is employed for classification, categorizing stocks based on learned representations from historical and technical indicators. Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO) optimizes the system's parameters, ensuring adaptability to dynamic market conditions. Notably, the system achieves an impressive accuracy of 97%, emphasizing its efficacy in making correct predictions. This multi-model approach, integrating LSTM, RNN, DBN, and GWO, provides a comprehensive and adaptive framework for navigating the complexities of stock market prediction. The study emphasizes the importance of choosing metrics aligned with specific goals and conducting thorough analysis to ensure the robustness of the evaluation results in the challenging and dynamic context of financial markets.

articleTitle: Sign Up Wallet: A Blockchain and Machine Learning based Self-Sovereign Identity Model for Enhanced Digital Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Digital identity management faces challenges with centralized and federated systems, risking large-scale data breaches and privacy violations. In response, this article presents the Sign-Up Wallet, a novel approach to digital identity management integrating blockchain and machine learning. The self-sovereign identity model leverages blockchain technology, eliminating the need for trusted third parties. Users store their digital identity in the Sign Up Wallet with cryptographic keys, enhancing security and control. During registration, a Unique Personal Identifier (UPI) Code ensures secure credential verification. Machine learning, specifically Logistic Regression, is employed to assess the trustworthiness of service providers, enabling users to make informed choices. In cases of untrusted providers, a Lookup Substitution Algorithm generates masked credentials, preserving user privacy during verification. The primary goal is to empower individuals with greater control over their digital identities, mitigating risks associated with centralized authorities and enhancing overall digital security.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Employee Depression Identification System Using Modified Learning Procedure with AI Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This study presents an innovative approach for employee depression identification by integrating advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) techniques. The Modified Learning Procedure with AI Assistance (MLPAI) is employed, combining Feature Extraction through RF, Classification using AlexNet, and Optimization facilitated by the Mayfly Optimization Algorithm The res earch aims to improve the precision of depression identification within the workforce. The Feature Extraction phase employs RF to robustly extract relevant features from diverse datasets. AlexNet, a deep learning classification model, is then employed for accurate categorization. The Mayfly optimization algorithm optimizes the system and fine-tuning parameters for increased precision. The experimental analysis involves a targeted examination of Millennial and Generation Z employees in South Korea, aged between 20 and 40. The implemented MLPAI system achieved an impressive accuracy of 97.34%, demonstrating its efficacy in identifying employee depression. The entire system has been implemented and documented in a Jupyter Notebook, providing a transparent and accessible framework for researchers and practitioners interested in replicating or extending this study. Through this comprehensive approach, the study aims to contribute valuable insights into the intersection of AI, mental health, and workplace dynamics, offering a novel framework for addressing and mitigating employee depression.

articleTitle: A Novel Wearable Device to Indicate Sciatic Nerve Pressure
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Sciatica, a symptom of a medical problem, affects around 40% of people across the globe. This research study highlights the impact of this ailment. Addressing sciatica promptly can enhance mobility and overall well-being for those affected. In this study, the sciatic nerve region is fitted with an Arduino Uno and a combination of flex sensor and temperature sensor. The flex sensor is used to gauge the subject's flexibility over the region. The Arduino Uno is used to organize the values from the sensors and for transmission. In this study, a device for measuring temperature is utilized to analyse the temperature distribution on the individual's sternum. An ECG sensor is used to analyse the electrical activity of the person and used for further diagnosis.

articleTitle: 5G and IoT Cloud Integration for Enhancing Connectivity and Data Management
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: This research analyzed the result of super-fast 5G networks on the IoT and explores how the cloud can enhance the performance and execution of smart devices in conjunction with 5G. The arrival of 5G, akin to a next-level internet, enables rapid and low-latency communication between sensors and smart devices. Leveraging the cloud, which serves as a vast computing resource on the internet, can further optimize the capabilities of these smart devices in a 5G environment. The incorporation of 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Generation and the cloud offers several significant outcomes. Firstly, it enhances connectivity by facilitating seamless and real-time data exchange among smart devices, enabling efficient interactions and improving overall system performance. Secondly, the cloud provides additional computing capacity and storage capacity, enabling smart devices to offload processing tasks and handle large volumes of generated data effectively. This capability enhances operational efficiency, particularly in domains such as self-driving cars and manufacturing, where real-time decision-making and advanced automation are critical. Moreover, the cloud's scalability and flexibility empower smart devices to adapt dynamically to changing demands. This capability allows businesses and individuals to scale their computing resources as needed, eliminating the need for substantial infrastructure investments. Additionally, the research addresses concerns regarding data management and security. By exploring cloud-based data handling techniques, it ensures efficient data processing while safeguarding privacy and implementing robust security measures for the interconnected ecosystem. In conclusion, this research aims to establish a symbiotic relationship between smart devices, 5G networks, and the cloud. Through this integration, it envisions a more connected and efficient IoT ecosystem, driving advancements in various industries, enhancing automation, and delivering an optimized user experience while upholding data privacy and security.

articleTitle: Development of Advanced Noise Filtering Techniques for Medical Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: Medical imaging modalities, including computed tomography (CT), magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), X-rays, and ultrasound, are extensively employed in the healthcare industry for diagnostic purposes. Noise, on the other hand, can disturb these approaches and lead to inaccurate diagnosis. Due to this problem, the significance of noise removal technologies has grown in the field of medical imaging, specifically for the examination and understanding of medical images and anatomical structures. To tackle these challenges, a variety of denoising techniques have been developed, such as the Weiner filter (WF), Gaussian filter, and median filter. This work employs a Deep Learning (DL) method known as Convolutional Autoencoder (CAE) to remove noise from medical images. We gather chest X-ray images for analysis and focus on common noise types that affect medical images, such as Poisson and Gaussian noise. We evaluate the effectiveness of the suggested denoising method CAE by comparing it to the commonly employed WF methodology. The Structural Similarity Index (SSIM) and Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) are employed to assess and compare the performance of the WF and CAE in reducing Poisson and Gaussian noise. The study's findings indicate that the suggested denoising method based on CAE shows promising results in terms of improving quality.

articleTitle: Emotion-Infused Music Recommender System Using Inception-ResNet V2 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Intelligent Communication Technologies and Virtual Mobile Networks (ICICV)
abstract: The ever-increasing volume of digital content, and the fusion of multimedia elements has become a promising technology for enhancing user experience in various applications. This research study explores the integration of image-based emotion detection to augment the capabilities of a music recommendation system. It presents a versatile application of the Inception-ResNet-V2 algorithm for real-time emotion detection using a web camera.
